Ready to take control of your payments?

Cherry makes managing your payment plans simple and stress-free. Pay your way, on your schedule - with clarity every step of the way.

- Manage multiple payment plans from one place
- Make payments in seconds with your preferred payment method
- Check your upcoming payments and plan for the future
- Track your progress - view your payment plan details and history

No guesswork. No surprises. Just a smarter way to pay.

----

What is Cherry?

Cherry’s “Buy Now, Pay Later” platform is revolutionizing how medical practices provide health and wellness services by enabling patients to access more comprehensive care and treatments through manageable payment plans. Cherry opens the door for a broader range of services and treatments to be financed, making wellness more accessible than ever before.

Payment options through Cherry Technologies, Inc. are issued by the following lending partners: https://withcherry.com/lending-partners. Not every practice that offers Cherry will offer the payment plan terms listed above. Term length, loan amount, 0% APR and other promotional rates are subject to eligibility. leads.description:
How many acres is it? Where are the property lines? How many fence posts, tons of gravel or bags of mulch does the job take? Tap the corners on a crisp satellite map and AreaMap shows you.

PROPERTY LINES ON THE MAP
County lot lines over the satellite map. Tap any lot for its size, side lengths and address, or measure the whole lot in one tap. Plan view draws clean lines and buildings when trees hide the ground.

MEASURE BY TAPPING OR WALKING
Search an address and tap the corners, or walk the boundary with GPS, even with the screen locked. Drag corners, cut out ponds and buildings, and see every side labeled in feet.

MATERIALS ESTIMATE FOR THE JOB
Turn the shape into a shopping list: fence posts, rails, chain link and gates, gravel in tons and truckloads, mulch, sod, seed, lime, concrete, sealcoat, hydroseed, roofing, snow and more.

QUOTES YOUR CLIENTS CAN READ
Price the job with your own rates and send a clean quote or PDF report with the map, measurements and your logo.

KNOW THE LAND BEFORE YOU BID (PRO+)
FEMA flood zones, wetlands, USDA soils, 2-ft contours and slope on the map and on every lot card, plus the owner, assessed value, last sale, tax and building details from county records where available.

SAVE AND EXPORT
Save measurements with names, notes and photos. Export KML for Google Earth, GPX, GeoJSON, CSV or a map image.

Built for fence, landscaping, paving, concrete and snow contractors, farmers, landowners and anyone who needs to know how big a piece of land is and what it takes.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
AreaMap is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Indonesian, Thai, Romanian and Ukrainian, and shows hectares and meters wherever they're the norm.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
You can explore the map and draw shapes for free. Measurement results, saving, walking a boundary, property lines, reports, exports, materials and quotes need AreaMap Pro; map layers, owner names, property values and sales need AreaMap Pro+; client reports, cut/fill and drainage, and the AI preview need AreaMap Max. Plans are billed yearly or monthly; the price for your country, and any free trial, are shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the trial ends if you start one. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://areamap.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://areamap.app/privacy

AreaMap measurements come from map imagery and GPS and are estimates. Property lines and county records are shown where available and are approximate. They are not a legal survey. For boundary disputes, sales or permits, use a licensed surveyor.

leads.description:
Everyone's sleepmaxxing. Almost nobody's measuring it. Somnr turns your iPhone and Apple Watch into a real sleep tracker, scores every night out of 100, and hands you the exact plan to fix it.

Track with just your phone on the mattress or nightstand, or pair your Apple Watch for even sharper, all-night detection. Your choice.

TRACK YOUR SLEEP, PHONE OR WATCH
Somnr measures your whole night:
→ Full hypnogram of deep, core, REM and awake, hour by hour
→ Time asleep, efficiency, awakenings, restlessness
→ Snore detection and sound analysis in Nightstand mode
→ Motion-based detection in Boost mode, phone on the mattress
→ Apple Watch support for higher-accuracy, all-night tracking
→ Your night live on the Lock Screen while you sleep
Wake up to a complete breakdown of how you actually slept.

WAKE UP AT THE RIGHT MOMENT
The smart alarm reads your sleep and wakes you in your lightest window before your target time, so you get up clear instead of groggy.

YOUR SLEEP SCORE
→ Scored out of 100, ranked Tier S to F
→ Built from the factors that actually move sleep: timing, consistency, caffeine, recovery, circadian rhythm
→ Your verdict, no fluff, in seconds

YOUR OPTIMAL DAY
Every morning, Somnr builds the day your sleep is actually asking for:
→ When your peak focus hits
→ Your best workout window
→ Your last-coffee deadline
→ Tonight's ideal bedtime
→ Your recovery window
Not a generic template. Your day, from your data.

LOG YOUR CRASHES AND THE APP LEARNS YOUR PATTERN
Crash at 3 PM? Somnr logs it. After a week it tells you when you crash most, and warns you 30 minutes before. Your own sleep journal, talking back. No AI marketing, just your data.

WATCH YOUR SLEEP IMPROVE
→ See how old your sleep makes your energy
→ Your most-improved factors, highlighted
→ Your full 30-day trend curve and night history
→ Before/after photo, stored locally, never shared, never uploaded

PRIVACY-FIRST
→ Your data stays on your iPhone
→ Apple Health read-only access
→ Before/after photos never leave your device
→ No account required to start

WHY SOMNR
Most sleep apps hand you numbers you can't read. Somnr gives you a story: how good your sleep really is, what's wrecking it, what's fixing it, and the exact plan to sleepmaxx it. Fix your sleep and sharper focus, more energy and a more rested face follow. No opaque scores. No automated coaching pretending to know you. Just your number, your data, and a clear plan.

SOMNR PRO
Somnr is free to download. Somnr Pro unlocks the full experience: night-by-night sleep tracking, your Sleep Score, the smart alarm, your Optimal Day, and full 30-day history.
Somnr Pro is an auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Prices may vary by region.

Terms of Use: https://somnr.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://somnr.app/privacy

leads.description:
Maths games for kids are engaging educational games for toddlers that help girls and boys aged 3 and up learn to count objects and solve simple addition and subtraction problems.
Play and explore the world of counting with kids' games! Solve puzzles, take quizzes, and complete educational tasks. No third-party advertising.

~~~ Features ~~~

• Ten exciting addition and subtraction puzzles for kids
Maths learning games give your child great practice. Learn basic concepts and develop new skills by solving simple maths problems in educational games for kids. Helpful clues are included in the preschool games to make learning easier and more enjoyable. Our learning games will help children understand the basics of counting and start school with elementary maths knowledge.

• Fascinating counting activities
Counting objects helps children learn number names, remember the correct number sequence, test their knowledge, and improve their counting skills. Young players need to look at the board, count the displayed objects, and solve the problem by choosing the correct number block. Solve as many problems as possible and learn to count in toddler games for children aged 3 and up!

• Comparison exercises
Play interesting nursery games and learn to identify which group has more or fewer items. Let your toddler look at the board, count the number of objects on the left and right sides, and then choose the correct maths symbol. Combine fun gameplay with useful learning in number games for kids!

• Develop fine motor skills in toddler learning games for kids
Maths learning games for preschool children are great for both learning basic maths and developing fine motor skills. We have created gameplay in which children select, tap, and drag different objects.

SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe now to get:
1. more maths puzzles
2. new quizzes
3. new exercises

Premium subscription details:
- Start with a free three-day trial. When the trial ends, a paid weekly subscription will begin automatically.
- Subscriptions are available in weekly, monthly, and annual plans.
- A weekly subscription costs $9.99, a monthly subscription costs $19.99, and an annual subscription costs $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription or free trial at any time. To prevent automatic renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
- Read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://jmhdevelopers.com/privacy.html
https://jmhdevelopers.com/terms_of_use.html

leads.description:
Life in the UK Test 2026 — Your Complete Toolkit to Pass with Confidence

Preparing for British Citizenship or Indefinite Leave to Remain?

Life in the UK Test 2026 helps thousands pass on their first attempt. Built on the official 3rd edition handbook, with 1,100+ exam-style questions, unlimited mock tests, and instant feedback — everything you need in one app.

---

Everything You Need to Pass

Based on Official Home Office Handbook
Study with content aligned to the official 3rd edition Life of the United Kingdom: A Guide for New Residents. Updated for 2026 to reflect UKVI recommendations. Ensures full coverage of all required topics.

Handbook Summaries for Faster Learning
Get clear, structured summaries of every chapter — ideal for quick revision and deeper understanding of key facts.

Unlimited Mock Tests
Train with as many exam-style tests as you need — each one follows the 24-question structure and is fully randomized.

1,100+ Exam-Like Questions
Master every topic with a comprehensive question bank designed to mirror the real test.

Instant Feedback & Clear Explanations
Learn faster with helpful explanations after each question and tips to reinforce difficult areas.

Smart Study Analytics
Track your progress and see exactly where to focus — strengths, weaknesses, completion levels, and more.

---

Study Tools to Boost Your Learning

Instant Weak Area Detection
Never waste time on topics you've already mastered. Know exactly what to study next.

Review All Incorrect Questions
Revisit mistakes in one tap to strengthen long-term memory.

Flag & Save Difficult Items
Build a personalised review list for more efficient practice.

Memory-Boosting Techniques
Learn proven methods to help you retain facts quickly and confidently.

---

Study in Your Own Way

- Clear English designed for non-native speakers
- Audio pronunciation for questions and answers
- Glossary of UK-specific terms
- Dark Mode for comfortable study anytime

---

From Today to Test Day

- Smart reminders keep you on track
- Watch your confidence grow with detailed progress charts
- Know exactly when you're test-ready
- Countdown to Test Day — stay focused as your exam approaches

---

Accurate & Always Up to Date

Fresh 2026 Content
Regularly updated to reflect UKVI recommendations and the latest handbook guidance.

Covers Key Application Info
Includes essential details about UK ID verification and next steps for Citizenship or ILR applications.

Reliability You Can Trust
Updates ensure you're always practising with current and accurate material.

---

Suitable For

- Applicants for British Citizenship (Naturalisation)
- ILR (Settlement) candidates
- Learners who prefer structured, clear, and efficient study tools
- Support workers, teachers, and volunteers who help others prepare

---

Subscription Information

Life in the UK Test 2026 offers optional premium features to enhance your preparation experience.

With a premium subscription, you can unlock:

- Full access to all 1,100+ exam-style questions
- Unlimited mock tests with advanced randomisation
- Complete handbook summaries
- Smart analytics, weak-area detection, and personalised study tools
- Progress tracking, reminders, and priority content updates
- An ad-free study experience

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings.

Access to premium features begins immediately after confirmation of purchase.

---

Need help? Contact us: support@edutrackers.com

Privacy Policy: https://edutrackers.com/privacy_policy

leads.description:
Keep your personal or family finances easily under control with Fast Budget.
You can check your daily expenses and improve your savings.
Visualize the flow of your money at a glance with the fully customizable Overview page.
In Fast Budget, you have many tools for managing better your money, like various types of charts or a useful calendar.
It is possible to sync your data between devices and connect your bank accounts.


Fast Budget - Expense Manager features:

ACCOUNTS AND CREDIT CARDS
Track your bank accounts and credit cards to stay on top of your finances.
Visualize your financial health through customizable charts that show account balances and spending trends over time.

TRANSACTIONS AND SCHEDULED TRANSACTIONS
Insert your revenues and outgoings in an easy and fast way.
There are various tools within this money manager to speed up the insertion of a transaction, like the transaction templates.
You can schedule your income or expenses to recur over time.

BUDGETS
Create custom budgets to always know how much money you still have available.
It's possible to select more than one category for each budget.

DEBTS
Track your debts and credits toward banks, friends or companies in a dedicated page.

CALENDAR
View your day-to-day profits and outlays. 
Be always aware of when and where you have spent. 
You can also view the scheduled payments in the next days.

SUMMARY
This is a handy section to see a summary of your cash flow in the last period.

OTHER
•  Synchronize up to five devices.
•  Web app available.
•  Dark mode.
•  Automatic backup in Dropbox to avoid data loss.
•  Protect your data with a passcode.
•  Reminder to not forget to insert your daily transactions.

Some features are not available in the free version.

leads.description:
Late fees and overdrafts can cost more than $30 each — and wreck your credit score. Bills to Budget is the modern checkbook register that helps you stay organized, track every bill, and know exactly what's cleared and what's still pending. If you've ever been surprised by a payment hitting your account at the wrong time, this app is for you.

FINALLY KNOW WHAT'S REALLY IN YOUR ACCOUNT

The biggest problem with online banking? It only shows what's cleared. Bills to Budget lets you mark payments as "Paid but not Cleared" — so you always know your true available balance, not just what the bank says. No more mental math. No more overdrafts from forgotten pending checks.

STAY AHEAD OF EVERY BILL

Add your bills once, and Bills to Budget reminds you before they're due. Mark a bill as paid, and it automatically resets for next month, next quarter, or whatever schedule you need. See everything organized by your pay schedule, so you always know what's due before your next paycheck arrives.

BUDGET WITHOUT THE SPREADSHEETS

Once your bills are under control, take the next step: create simple spending budgets and track purchases as they happen. See exactly where your money goes — whether you pay by check, debit card, or cash. Get alerts when you're close to overspending, so you can adjust before it's too late.

SEE YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE

The calendar view shows your complete financial picture: upcoming bills, paydays, and projected balances all in one place. Spot problems days or weeks before they become stress. Know exactly how much you can afford to spend today.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE

- Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with seamless iCloud sync
- Supports multiple accounts — checking, savings, credit cards
- Tracks check numbers for your checkbook register
- Family sharing lets everyone stay on the same page
- Widgets put your bills and budgets front and center
- Siri Shortcuts support for quick access

Bills to Budget brings the reliability of a traditional checkbook register into the modern age — helping you organize your bills, track your spending, and finally feel in control of your money.

leads.description:
Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker is the simplest and fastest app to manage your budgets, track your expenses, and save money on the go.

Take control of your budget by allocating your expenses into different envelopes such as groceries, salary, fuel, hobbies, shopping, vacations, and more. Whether it's recurring expenses or special events, Tracky lets you track your monthly or one-time budgets.

Track your expenses and make the most of your savings with Tracky’s automatic calculation of your remaining budget. This fast and easy budget tracking tool is suitable for everyone, regardless of their expertise in budget management. Rest assured, Tracky doesn't require any connection to your bank account, ensuring your data and privacy remain secure.

Why should you use Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker?

- Quick and easy
- Free
- Allocate your budget
- Track your expenses
- Enjoy your savings
- No sign-up or login required
- No bank account needed
- Private & secure: we don't collect your data, it's safe for you
- Automatic iCloud sync to share data across multiple devices logged in to the same iCloud account

=== TRACKY: SIMPLE BUDGET TRACKER FEATURES ===

- Create and manage your budgets
- Add and customize your operations: name, amount, date, icon, color
- Automatic calculation of your remaining budget
- Stay informed about your budget's progress with notifications
- Keep a history of your expenses
- Save time by reusing recurring budgets
- Easily share your data across multiple devices logged in to the same iCloud account
- Widgets: instantly monitor your budget from your lock screen and home screen

How to use Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker:

1. Create a budget and give it a name (e.g., "July")
2. Define and customize your envelopes (e.g., "Groceries," "Fuel," "Hobbies")
3. Add your expenses to the envelopes
4. Enter the expense name and amount
5. Personalize the expense by selecting an icon and color
6. Continue adding your expenses as you go, and Tracky will calculate the remaining budget

As you can see, Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker is incredibly simple and fast to use. It's the perfect solution for tracking your expenses and budgets without wasting time on understanding the app or linking your bank account, which could compromise your data. Managing your expenses has never been easier, faster, and more efficient.

Easily set and monitor your monthly or one-time budgets. Modify them anytime to adapt to your financial situation. Track your expenses accurately and identify areas where you can save. Dive into the detailed expense history for a deeper analysis of your spending habits. Identify trends, strengths, and areas for improvement to optimize your budget.

Tracky is the easiest and most convenient app to track your budgets, so what are you waiting for? Download Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker now!

***

Our app is FREE to use. However, you can become premium with in-app purchases. You'll have unlimited budgets, envelopes, and expenses, and no ads will be displayed to ensure optimal user experience.

All prices are in euros (EUR). Prices in other currencies and countries may vary depending on the country of residence.

Thank you for using Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker. Support us by sharing the app with your loved ones and giving us a 5-star rating on the App Store. Your support will enable us to continue improving the app and provide you with an even better financial management experience.

leads.description:
Simple Budget is a hands-on budgeting app for people who want control over where their money goes.

SEE WHERE YOUR MONEY GOES
Break your spending down into categories, and give each category a budget. By planning your spending ahead of time, you can build savings directly into your budget, allowing you to have guilt-free spending money while still keeping up with your savings. Track your spending habits with Simple Budget to see if your spending matches your goals.

HANDS-ON, WITHOUT THE HASSLE
Stay close to your spending to see exactly where your money is going. Avoid the set-it-and-forget-it model and plan for every dollar. When you see each one coming in and out, you understand what you're spending and what you're saving.

PLAN FOR THE FUTURE, LEARN FROM THE PAST
• Plan your spending ahead of time, from retirement savings to weekend shopping.
• Budget Calculator: see how your month ends up after the bills you know are coming, before you decide on that splurge.
• Projected spending and savings for the current month.
• Recurring income on any schedule: weekly, biweekly, monthly and more.
• Year Savings: income, spending and savings for every month of the year.
• Spending History: track your spending habits month to month.

ENVELOPE BUDGETING, MADE EASY
Building your budget is quick and easy with customizable, pre-built budget categories. Find what applies to you, tailor it to your needs, and build a budget that works for you.

YOUR BUDGET, YOUR WAY
• Track balances across your accounts, free.
• Search, filter and sort every transaction, free.
• Export your transactions to CSV anytime, free.
• Sign in with your phone number and pick up your budget on any device, free.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Simple Budget is built for everyone, and stays affordable for anyone looking for extra budgeting firepower.
The core of Simple Budget is free: budgets and categories, transactions, accounts, income, monthly insights and CSV export.
Premium adds detailed category insights and trends, yearly insights, full Budget Calculator editing, history from previous years, and more.

Simple Budget Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or annually. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Questions or ideas? luke@pgmediasolutions.com

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.gosimplebudget.com/privacy-policy

Ever open your banking app and wonder where the money went? Money Gone?! shows you – in a few seconds a day, with no bank linking, no account and no ads.

Log an expense in three taps, or snap a photo of the receipt and let AI read the amount, date and category for you. Set a monthly budget and always know how much is still safe to spend. That's it – money tracking that finally sticks.

WHY PEOPLE STAY WITH MONEY GONE?!

• Add expenses in seconds – quick entry designed for daily use
• Scan receipts – AI reads the amount, date and category automatically
• Monthly budget – see what's left, your daily allowance and a month-end forecast

• Recurring expenses – subscriptions, rent and bills log themselves

• Smart statistics – top categories and trends by day, week, month or year

• Daily summary – an evening notification with today's spending and balance

• 120+ currencies, light and dark mode, colorful themes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

SIMPLE ON PURPOSE

Money Gone?! is for people who quit complicated budget planners. No spreadsheets to configure, no accounts to connect – just open, add, and see where your money goes.

leads.description:
Welcome to Accountit, a simple, but powerful daily transactions tracker that will definitely help you get a full picture of your finances. With Accountit, tracking and organizing all of your transactions becomes as effortless as possible, all thanks to the useful features that the app has on offer.

Accountit lets you add an unlimited number of transactions that can be organized into different categories that you can create and customize yourself. With Accountit, you can also filter and organize all of your transactions even more efficiently using tags that you can create and assign to any of your transactions in the app.

Don’t worry if you have any recurring transactions because we have got you covered too! Just mark a transaction as recurring and set the frequency when adding it, Accountit will handle the rest for you and you won’t need to manually add the same exact transactions every single time. With Accountit, you can also add various attachments, such as receipts, to your transactions in no time at all because you can scan receipts and take photos directly in the app. One of the main goals of the app is to help you quickly analyze all of your transactions and this is why Accountit offers a dedicated Summary screen that displays an extensive variety of information based on your transactions.

Accountit is built with privacy and security in mind and it just doesn’t collect any personal data that can be linked to you. All of your data in the app is stored locally on your device and synced via iCloud if you have enabled this functionality in the settings of the app. We have designed Accountit to be as intuitive and easy to use as possible and it will definitely feel right at home on any of your Apple devices, all thanks to its native design.

Accountit offers an extensive variety of features that you can use completely for free, but if you feel that the free functionality isn’t enough for your needs, you can always upgrade to Accountit Plus for even better experience. With Accountit Plus, you get an access to an unlimited number of accounts, categories, and tags, as well as various app customization options, and more.

KEY FEATURES:
- Unlimited number of transactions
- iCloud sync
- Ability to add notes to your transactions
- Ability to add links to your transactions
- Income, expense, and transfer transactions
- 1 account
- Budgets
- Recurring transactions
- Multiple sorting and filtering options to help you better organize your transactions
- Transactions summary
- CSV import and export
- Beautiful and useful widgets
- Available on iOS, iPadOS, macOS and watchOS

PLUS FEATURES:
- Unlimited number of accounts
- Access to categories and tags
- iCloud sharing
- Ability to add attachments to transactions
- 10 different app icons for you to pick the one that fits your home screen the most
- 15 different tint colors that you can choose from to make the app feel more unique to you
- Custom appearance (System, light, and dark)
- More than 150 different currencies
- Bulk editing

If you have any questions about Accountit, you can just get in touch with us via email at info@designtech.so. We are always happy to help!

leads.description:
Turn your dreams into a plan with Moneybox — your personal savings manager and digital piggy bank. Whether you're saving for a new car, a dream vacation, a home, education or a rainy day, Moneybox makes putting money aside simple, visual and genuinely motivating.

Create as many money boxes as you have goals, give each one a name, color and icon, set a target, and watch your progress bar fill as your savings grow. Add a deposit whenever it suits you, week by week or month by month, and feel the quiet satisfaction of getting closer to what you want.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE MONEYBOX

• Unlimited money boxes — one for every goal, big or small.
• Personalized — name each box and choose its color and icon.
• Goal tracker — set a target and follow your progress visually.
• Starting balance — begin a box with the savings you already have.
• Deposit or withdraw — manage your money flexibly, anytime.
• Progress bar — see at a glance how close you are to each goal.
• Detailed history — review every deposit and spot your saving trends.
• Educational content — handy tips to grow your financial know-how.
• Works offline — light & dark themes — available in 70+ languages.

WHY A MONEYBOX WORKS

Saving is hard when it's abstract. By giving every goal its own box, a clear target and a progress bar you can actually see, Moneybox makes the habit stick. Small, regular deposits feel effortless — and watching the bar inch forward is exactly the encouragement you need to keep going.

ONE APP, EVERY GOAL

Keep your holiday fund separate from your emergency fund, and your gadget savings apart from your gift budget. With unlimited, fully customizable boxes, you always know precisely how much you've set aside and what it's for — no spreadsheets, no guesswork.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Create a money box and set your goal.
2. Add deposits whenever you can.
3. Watch the progress bar grow until you reach your target.

PERFECT FOR

• Saving for a car, home, trip, wedding or gadget.
• Building an emergency or rainy-day fund.
• Teaching kids the habit of saving.
• Anyone who wants to reach their financial goals faster.

Every big goal starts with a single deposit. With Moneybox as your savings companion, you'll build better money habits, stay motivated, and finally turn "someday" into a real date on the calendar.

SAVING, MADE SATISFYING

Money goals fail when they feel like sacrifice. Moneybox flips that feeling: every deposit is a small, visible win, and every progress bar a little hit of motivation. Instead of vaguely "trying to save", you watch real momentum build — and that momentum is what carries you all the way to the goal.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE

Save at your own pace, on your own schedule. Pop in spare change after payday, add a lump sum when you can, or set steady weekly amounts — Moneybox adapts to however you like to save. And because everything works offline and stays on your device, your plans are always private and always with you.

SET GOALS YOU'LL ACTUALLY REACH

• Break a big target into small, manageable deposits.
• Give every goal a deadline and a clear finish line.
• Celebrate as each box fills up and your savings grow.

Moneybox savings tracker and piggy bank: create unlimited money boxes, set financial goals, deposit and withdraw, track progress with a visual bar and history, and save for a car, vacation, home or emergency fund.

Download Moneybox today and start saving for what matters most.

Privacy Policy: https://www.shpavda.com/products/moneybox/privacy/
Terms & Conditions: https://www.shpavda.com/products/moneybox/terms/ios/

leads.description:
Master Your Focus, Conquer Your Exams
Struggling with procrastination? Overwhelmed by exam stress? Meet the study companion designed to turn chaos into productivity. Whether you’re a medical student managing revision, a professional fighting ADHD time blindness, or just trying to finish that essay—this is the focus tool you’ve been waiting for.

WHY STUDENTS & ADHD BRAINS LOVE US:

Scientific Pomodoro Technique
Break work into manageable 25-minute intervals (or customize your own!). The rhythm of "Focus" and "Break" keeps your mind fresh and prevents burnout. Perfect for the Pomodoro method enthusiasts who need structure.

Built for ADHD & Neurodivergence
We understand the struggle of "starting." Our low-friction interface and gentle reminders act as a digital body double, helping you overcome executive dysfunction and stay on track. Say goodbye to time blindness.

Immersive Study Environment
Block out distractions with built-in white noise, Lo-fi beats, rain sounds, and library ambience. Turn your phone into a sanctuary of concentration, no matter where you are.

Track Your Progress
Meaningful analytics show you exactly when you are most productive. Visualize your study streaks, track total focus hours, and categorize time by subject (Math, Coding, Biology, Work).

KEY FEATURES:

Customizable Timer: Set 25/5, 50/10, or any custom interval to suit your flow.

Live Activities & Widgets: Check your remaining time directly from your Lock Screen or Dynamic Island (iPhone 14 Pro/15/16).

Aesthetic Themes: Choose from Minimalist, Dark Mode, or Cute themes to match your studygram aesthetic.

Flip Clock Mode: A classic full-screen digital clock designed to keep you off your phone.

Background Mode: Timer runs perfectly while you use other essential study apps.

PERFECT FOR:

High School & University Students preparing for SATs, GCSEs, or Finals.

Remote Workers & Freelancers needing structure.

Anyone with ADHD, ADD, or Executive Function challenges.

Language Learners & Avid Readers.

Stop scrolling and start achieving. Download Pomodoro Focus Timer - Study now and reclaim your attention!

=== Subscription options ===
The app is free to download, but to access premium features, a subscription is required. With the subscription, you'll enjoy uninterrupted access to our premium features. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account within 24 hours before the end of the current period.

If you wish to cancel the automatic renewal of your subscription, you can do so at any time by accessing your iTunes account settings. However, please note that refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To ensure a successful cancellation, please make sure to turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Need help? Contact us at:
Email: andychung.cc@gmail.com

- Terms & Privacy
By using this app, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
Terms of Use: https://pomodoro.andyrgb.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pomodoro.andyrgb.com/privacy

• Start and stop a task's stopwatch with a tap.
• Run multiple stopwatches when you need to track different activities.
• Add or edit time entries, including their start and end times.
• Add notes to record what you worked on.
• Set reminders for running stopwatches.

ORGANIZE TASKS AND SET GOALS
• Group tasks into folders for clients, projects, or routines.
• Use tags to organize tasks, time entries, and notes.
• Choose colors to make tasks and folders easier to recognize.
• Set daily, weekly, or monthly time goals for a task, folder, or tag.
• Follow goal progress and review past days, weeks, and months.
• Archive completed work while keeping its history.

UNDERSTAND YOUR TIME AND BILLABLE WORK
• Review tracked time, activity, and trends in the dashboard.
• Filter your reports by task, folder, or tag.
• Set hourly rates for tasks and folders to calculate billable amounts.
• Add billable notes for work that does not use a stopwatch.
• Generate PDF reports for a chosen date range.
• Export entries to CSV for use in spreadsheets and other tools.
• Import CSV data and create manual backups.

MADE FOR YOUR APPLE DEVICES
Enjoy a refreshed design with Liquid Glass and layouts that fit the screen you use.

On Mac, start and stop timers from the menu bar without opening the main window. Add desktop widgets for quick access to tasks and running stopwatches.

Timesheet — the time tracker for freelancers, contractors, and self-employed professionals.

Log billable hours in seconds. Start a timer with one tap, photograph a receipt to log an expense, and turn tracked work into invoice-ready timesheets. No clutter, no admin overhead — just precise time tracking on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.

Built for people who get paid by the hour
Whether you bill clients, log overtime for HR, or track personal projects, Timesheet keeps every minute accounted for. Add notes, tags, rates, and mileage to each entry. Tag work as billable, paid, or invoiced. Export to Excel or CSV when it's time to bill.

Smart automation that respects your battery
• Location-based timer — start tracking automatically when you arrive at a client site
• NFC tag automation — tap an NFC sticker to start or stop the timer
• Wi-Fi triggers — start the timer when you connect to your office network
• Smart Break Reminders with three modes:
  – Time-based: simple interval reminders
  – Health-aware: uses Apple Health (heart rate, steps) to suggest breaks
  – Adaptive: learns from your personal work patterns
• Forgotten timer detection — get notified when a timer has been running unusually long
• Tracking reminders — learns when you usually work and nudges you if you forget to start

Powerful on every Apple device
• Apple Watch app — start, stop, and check elapsed time from your wrist
• CarPlay — start, pause, and stop the timer from the car screen, with automatic mileage on the drive
• Control Center toggle and Action Button support (iOS 18)
• Home Screen widgets — at-a-glance daily, weekly, and monthly totals
• Siri Shortcuts and Universal Links — automate your workflow
• Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, full accessibility support

Built-in reports and exports
• Daily, weekly, monthly statistics with project breakdowns
• Export to Excel (.xlsx) and CSV with custom sorting
• Work Patterns — evenings, nights and weekends worked, computed on device
• Local backup and restore
• Offline-first — works without an internet connection

Privacy-first by design
• Your data stays on your device unless you opt into Cloud Sync
• No ads, no third-party trackers
• Local SQLite database

Timesheet Plus — Continue your work on every device
• Cloud sync between iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch
• Automatic, GDPR-compliant cloud backups
• Smart tag suggestions based on project and time of day

Timesheet Pro — Everything Plus, plus the tools serious freelancers and small teams need
• Calendar Sync — your tracked hours appear in iOS Calendar automatically
• Invoices from your phone — PDF with your branding, ready to send
• AI Insights — work rhythm, projects, finances and breaks
• Web app access at my.timesheet.io — manage everything from any browser
• Advanced analytics and reports with custom export fields
• Scheduled email reports to clients
• Team collaboration with shared projects and role-based permissions
• QuickBooks and Zapier integrations
• API access for developers
• Priority support

Timesheet Plus and Pro are auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage and cancel anytime in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

Questions or feedback? Contact us anytime: office@timesheet.io

Download Timesheet today and take control of your time.

leads.description:
Toggl brings time tracking and planning into one place. Track your hours, manage your tasks, and build work plans based on real data, not guesswork. Work with confidence and clarity.
Anyone who wants to easily track time and plan work better can benefit from Toggl — whether you’re a team manager, individual contributor, or freelancer.

START A TIMER IN ONE TAP
The timer is always within reach, from any screen. Toggl shows you how long your work really takes, so you can plan realistic personal and team schedules, make confident decisions, and maximize productivity.

MANAGE TASKS AND PROJECTS, ALONGSIDE TRACKED HOURS
Add a task from anywhere with one button. Connect with projects, priorities, dates, and estimates. Sort based on your needs and star what matters.

SEE YOUR WHOLE DAY AT A GLANCE, IN ONE PLACE
Tasks, projects, calendar events, and tracked time in a single view. No switching apps to work out what's next.

KNOW WHERE YOUR TIME WENT
Reports turn your tracked hours into something you can act on, whether that's a fairer estimate, a cleaner invoice or a shorter week. 

CONNECT TIME TO PROFITABILITY
Easily capture billable hours and compare them against non-billable time. Add labor costs to understand project or client profitability. 

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Your data syncs with Toggl on web, macOS and Windows, so the timer you start on your phone is waiting for you at your desk.

MANAGE YOUR TEAM OR WORK SOLO
Toggl can be used by both teams and individual users. The seamless time tracking, flexible task management, and powerful reporting remain the same regardless.

BUILT FOR REAL WORK, NOT SURVEILLANCE
No screenshots, no activity monitoring, no nagging. Toggl is a tool you use, not one that watches you. 

Already using Toggl Track? You can keep using it — it’s supported and updated, with no sunset date. Toggl is a separate app, built around planning as well as tracking, so you can do much more with your time data.
Built by the team behind Toggl Track. Download Toggl and get your time back.

Privacy Policy - https://toggl.com/legal/focus/privacy/
Need Help? Go to https://community.toggl.com/c/focus-faq/27

leads.description:
Ever felt like you can't complete a goal? Or that you can't break a bad habit?

Sometimes you just need to have patience to achieve your goals, and the aim of this app is to help you with that.

Just create a counter inside the app and start counting! The counter will keep counting upwards, showing you the days since you quit your habit(until you stop it). The app isn't limited to one counter either, you can create up to 3 different types of counters in the app for free.

It can be used for things like quitting soda, fast food, smoking or almost anything else.

There's also a ranking system for how long you've abstained from your bad habit to give you a new-found sense of achievement.

If you use up all of your three counter slots you can send some counters you aren't using anymore to your 'archive' and restore them when you need them again.

If you're looking for a days since counter, this is it. Don't delay things any further, try it today!

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/kintimer-app
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/kintimer-terms

leads.description:
Study timer with custom targets that will end your procrastination forever! Pomodoro time tracking with targets is your answer to getting more done. How much does it suck pulling an all nighter because you left your study to the last minute. Or the disappointment of your side project losing momentum.

With Milki, you can set variable daily targets for each activity and track against them over a defined period e.g. 2 weeks or 2 months. The Actual vs. Target (worm) chart is incredibly powerful at keeping you on track, you can visually track your performance over the period. No other focus timer app does this, so I had to create one that did haha. 

Milki also uses the Pomodoro productivity hack of 25 minute intervals. With the combination of the Pomodoro technique & Actual vs. Target tracking, you will be shocked at the improvement for your study, work or side projects. 

CUSTOM TARGETS
• Set variable daily targets for each activity e.g. Study or Side Project.
• Actual vs. Target chart, the ultimate way to stay on track. 
• See how you are tracking against your targets over the defined period.

FOCUS TIMER
• Perform focus timer intervals. 
• Utilizes the Pomodoro Technique.
• Short & long breaks between sessions. 

SYNC MULTIPLE DEVICES
• One account for all your devices.

ACTIVITIES
• Create activities like Study, Work, Side Project, Life Admin or Chem 101.
• Quickly switch between activities.
• Charts and metrics for each activity. 

CLEAN & BEAUTIFUL DESIGN
• Incredible design & animations.
• Miki is seriously cute.

CHARTS
• Actual vs. Target charts, track your performance over time. 
• Charts for each activity, quickly switch between tasks / activities.  
• Daily, weekly, monthly charts for each activity e.g. Physics 101. 

STATUS LEVELS
• As you do more sessions, you will climb the status levels and unlock more features!
• Status Levels including NOOB, BRONZE, SILVER, GOLD & PLATINUM. 
• Gain access to exclusive features and benefits at each status level increase. 

LEADERBOARD
• Streak leaderboard.
• Daily, weekly, monthly & lifetime leaderboards!

FEATURE REQUESTS
• Email me directly if you have feature requests, at hello@milki.app

LANGUAGES
• English
• Turkish
• French
• German
• Italian
• Brazilian Portuguese
• Malay

SAY HI
My name is Chris, I developed Milki & I’m from Brisbane, Australia.
I’m actively building features for Milki! Let me know if you have feature requests or suggestions. 
I will reply to your email ridiculously fast (if I am awake, Australia time zone).
Email: hello@milki.app

MILKI PRO
• Sync multiple devices.
• Customize session time.
• Customize alarm sounds.
• Customize long breaks.
• Combined weekly & monthly charts.
Milki offers auto-renewing subscriptions:
• $11.99 billed annually.
The subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled more than 24 hours in advance of the period. Your account will be charged the subscription price within 24 hours of the period ending. To manage your active subscriptions, go to App Store settings. You can only get the introductory price once. The price above is in USD, prices may vary between countries & with local exchange rates.

  Use the contribution calendar, streaks, and study charts to see your habits over time and stay accountable.

leads.description:
Audio Flashcards lets you study without looking at a screen. Each card is a short recording of a question and its answer. You listen to the question, think of the answer, then listen to the answer to check yourself. Grade how well you knew it, and spaced repetition decides when the card comes back.

It works anywhere you can listen: on a walk, in the car, at the gym or while cooking. Use it to learn a language, build vocabulary, prepare for an exam, or memorize anything you need to know.

Review hands-free
Turn on autoplay and each card plays by itself, with a pause you choose before the answer. Grade cards and move between them with voice commands, in your own language. On iPhone you can also grade from the Lock Screen or the Dynamic Island, and your headphone and car controls work too.

Create cards in minutes
Record the question and the answer in your own voice, then trim or fix any part of the recording. Prefer typing? Choose a voice to read your text aloud: the voices built into your device, natural Kokoro voices that run offline, or Amazon Polly through your own account. You can also import a spreadsheet or a folder of audio files.

Spaced repetition that fits you
Audio Flashcards schedules reviews with FSRS, a modern spaced repetition algorithm. Grade each card Again, Hard, Good or Easy, choose how much you want to remember, and the app plans every review for you. Practice sessions let you study ahead without changing your schedule, and statistics show your progress and streak.

Your cards on every device
Organize cards into folders, each with its own settings. Transcribe your recordings and search the words you said. iCloud keeps iPhone, iPad and Mac in sync, and the Mac app has a sidebar, menus and keyboard shortcuts.

Shared Cards
Browse collections made by other learners, listen before you download, and keep your progress when a collection is updated. Publish your own for everyone, or share it privately with a link.

Free to use
Audio Flashcards is free with ads on iPhone and iPad. A subscription or a one-time purchase removes them, and the Mac app has no ads. Cloud voices use your own provider account.

Questions or ideas? Contact me in the app under Settings > Contact.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Use flashcards, spaced-repetition, and your Apple Pencil to study with Feyn!

Taking your own notes by hand and spaced-repetition are the best way to learn new concepts, and with Feyn you can do just that. Open up a book on your iPad and comfortably draw your flashcards right there using your Apple Pencil in Feyn. The flashcards are phone-sized so that you can then take them on the go and comfortably review them on your iPhone! Their vertical shape also makes them easy to write while multi-tasking on your iPad, and perfect for learning languages written top to bottom like Japanese. If you don't feel like drawing, just type some text using your keyboard or drop images into your flashcards.

In this way, you *learn* on your iPad as you think of how to you summarize new concepts into flashcards, and *memorize* on your iPhone while you review them on the go!

Feyn is fully featured, you can share flashcard to study with your friends. Your flashcards will automatically synchronize between your devices using your iCloud drive. Feyn also supports iOS' Quick Note, Handoff, and keyboard input: type away on your iPad or on our macOS app!

Feyn uses spaced repetition to aid in learning. It will ask you to review flashcards depending on how well you recall them, flashcards you miss will be asked more often, and flashcards you get right less often. This way you minimize the total time you spend studying and maximize retention!

Feyn Pro ads some nice to have extra features like study charts, to see how well you're learning, and flashcard importing. All other features are free and unrestricted. We guarantee that you will always be able to have a complete study experience for free.

Learn Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Mandarin), Arabic, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian, or Thai, all inside a real online video game.

Langlandia is the first language learning app built like an actual video game with online play. Instead of wasting time on an addictive game, learn a language with one. For all ages, from complete beginners to advanced learners.

TRAP YOUR FIRST BEAST
To survive Langlandia and advance in the institution, you need a strong beast at your side. Will it be a ferocious polar bear? A noble lion? A tiger, wolf, or giant snake? Or will you get lucky and trap a mythical beast, like a yeti or even a dragon?

You'll raise your baby beast and grow together: it becomes more powerful while you become fluent. You're a team, and you'll need each other to find your way home from this mysterious island.

TALK TO YOUR BEAST (NEW)
Have real conversations with your beast in the language you're learning. Practice speaking without fear of embarrassment. Your beast always listens, answers, and helps you improve.

SPEAK FROM DAY ONE
Langlandia doesn't just play audio. It listens to YOU. Speak into the mic, get instant feedback on your pronunciation, and take speaking exams as you progress. If your goal is to actually talk, not just tap answers, this is the game for you.

BATTLE PLAYERS AROUND THE WORLD
Face friends and other learners in 1v1 arena battles to prove who's mastering the language fastest. Battle live with your voice against real people. Then go further: tournaments, weekly competitions, challenges, online boss battles, and exam competitions. Compete for prizes and stay motivated every day.

CLANS, CLASS WARS & COMMUNITY
Join a clan and fight alongside other learners. Every word in the game has notes and comments from thousands of fellow students. See their memory tricks and add your own. Teachers: enroll your classes in Class Wars and let them battle rival classes all season.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
• The most common words: the highest-frequency vocabulary, so you pick up the language as fast as possible
• Numbers: count all the way to 100 million
• Verbs: conjugate past, present, and future tenses, the backbone of the grammar
• Sentences: the building blocks that let you construct anything you want to say
• Grammar: rules explained and practiced until they stick
• Everything you need to start actually speaking

STUDY TOOLS THAT STICK
Flashcards with native audio let you learn words before battle, and every word is spoken aloud again and again as you play, so pronunciation and listening skills sink in without you even trying. All set to an original soundtrack.

READING PRACTICE
20+ books, half set in the world of Langlandia. Don't know a word? Tap it for an instant translation. Then head to town, answer questions about what you read, and earn potions and points for your beast.

A REAL GAME, A REAL JOURNEY
Graduate through the grades of the institution by defeating its teachers, unlocking new words, sentences, and books as you go. Collect spirits, open chests, earn gems, and unlock rare titles along the way. Thousands of hours of gameplay, and every bit of vocabulary can be unlocked free, just by playing.

FOR EVERY LEVEL
Already advanced? Hard mode's lightning-fast battles train you to understand at native speed, because real people won't slow down for you. Just starting? Easy and Normal modes meet you exactly where you are.

PLAY OFFLINE
Play as much as you want without a connection. Your progress saves automatically.

Tired of language apps that feel like homework? Trap your beast, start your adventure, and download Langlandia now.

leads.description:
Fluency is not an app feature. It's a system.

Teacher AI gets you speaking a new language out loud, corrects every mistake, turns the words you use into flashcards, and tracks your progress word by word. It was designed by some of the most accomplished polyglots in the world.

SPEAK OUT LOUD
• Talk with realistic AI teachers by voice, face to face, or hands-free
• Practice as long as you like, any time of day, with no one judging you
• Conversations and role plays that adapt to your level

EVERY MISTAKE, CORRECTED
• See what you said next to what a native speaker would say
• Tap "Why?" for a short explanation of the grammar behind the fix
• Save any correction as a flashcard with one tap

FLASHCARDS FROM YOUR OWN WORDS
• Review the words you actually used, in the sentence you found them
• Hear every card read aloud

SEE YOUR FLUENCY GROW
• Count the words you can actively use, in every language you learn
• Keep your streak going and see your weekly practice time, speaking and listening
• Climb the leaderboard, ranked by the words you speak

BEGINNER TRACK FOR SPANISH AND FRENCH
Starting from zero? The Beginner Track is built on the Brick Method. Instead of memorizing vocabulary lists, you learn bricks: useful words, each chosen to unlock the most new sentences. You speak in full sentences from day 1, and every lesson builds on the last. Our co-founder and polyglot coach Lucas Bighetti guides you through each one.

FLUENCY TRACK FOR 60+ LANGUAGES
Studied before, but not fluent yet? You know more than you can say. The Fluency Track closes that gap with realistic conversations in more than 60 languages, including Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Russian and many more.

PRACTICE WITH TEACHERS YOU FOLLOW
We built Teacher AI with popular language teachers from YouTube and social media. Practice with their AI versions as much as you want, without feeling guilty about taking their time.

BUILT BY LANGUAGE LEARNERS
Teacher AI was co-founded by Arieh Smith (Xiaoma), the polyglot behind one of YouTube's most watched language channels; Olly Richards, author and founder of StoryLearning; Lucas Bighetti, who speaks more than 20 languages; and Jan van der Aa, who runs a leading network for online language entrepreneurs.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION, EVERY LANGUAGE
Start for free. A subscription unlocks unlimited practice in every language we offer, on both tracks, in the app and on the web.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://yourteacher.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://yourteacher.ai/privacy

leads.description:
You've studied. You've done the lessons. And a real person says one sentence to you and your mind goes blank. Speak City is a language game where the levels are real places — and the only way forward is to actually speak.

Speak City isn't a flashcard deck, a chatbot tutor, or another course you'll abandon by Wednesday. It's the first language game where the conversation IS the curriculum: real scenes, spoken out loud, judged honestly — and a city that opens as you speak.

HOW SPEAK CITY WORKS
1. You land in a city where nobody speaks your language — with nothing but your passport.
2. Every level is a real place with a real goal — order breakfast from the barista, get your medicine past a chatty pharmacist, talk your way into the party.
3. You speak. Out loud, in your own words. The characters listen, react, and speak back.
4. Every scene ends with a fair verdict: the transcript of what you actually said, what worked, what to fix — and an instant free retry.

Win the scene, stamp your passport, and the city keeps opening — from surviving your first café to holding your own at a table full of locals.

AN HONEST VERDICT, NOT A GOLD STAR
You've had the apps that cheer everything you say — and the false sense of progress that comes with them. Speak City tells you how you really did: kindly, clearly, and with the exact words to do better. Progress you can feel, because it's real.

YOU CAN NEVER FAIL — AND YOU CAN'T FAKE IT
Stuck mid-scene? The world helps: the character slows down, rephrases, offers a hint, a local friend whispers the phrase you need. A total beginner still walks out with the win. The scene adapts to your level — the verdict never lies about it.

A CITY, NOT A COURSE
No template drills. Every scene is culture-native — the café banter, the pharmacy manners, the dinner-table chaos are true to the place, illustrated like somewhere you'd want to visit. Your passport fills with stamps, districts unlock, and the map is your progress bar.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO'VE DONE THE OTHER STUFF
School classes. The apps. Maybe a tutor. You can pass a quiz — you just can't order a coffee. You don't need more vocabulary lists; you need somewhere safe to actually talk. Speak City is for the part of you that learned a language to speak it.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Subscribe to Speak City Plus to unlock the full city — every district, scene, and character.
Speak City Plus is offered as an auto-renewing subscription. A free trial may be available. If a free trial is offered, you'll be charged your subscription fee as soon as the trial period is over. If not, you'll be charged to your iTunes account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
You can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal via Account Settings after purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
Renewal charges will be applied to your account within the 24 hours preceding the end of the current period.
Cancelled subscriptions remain active until the period ends; auto-renewal is stopped, but refunds are not provided for the current period.
Unused free trial portions are lost if a subscription is purchased.

Privacy Policy: https://languagegame.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://languagegame.ai/tos

leads.description:
Is your goal to ACTUALLY SPEAK a new language? Tired of gamified tapping apps that just waste your time? Try Natulang! While other language-learning apps may focus on tapping and typing, Natulang is all about speaking. Our cutting-edge voice generation and recognition capabilities allow you to learn real-life dialogues by speaking them out loud, giving you the confidence you need to speak with native speakers. With Natulang, you'll spend most of your time speaking, which is the key to mastering any language. 

Currently supported languages:
Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (BR), Dutch, Turkish, Ukrainian, Polish, Czech, English, Japanese

Why Natulang?

•Speak your way to fluency: With Natulang, you'll spend most of your time speaking, which is the key to mastering any language.
•Real-life dialogues: Our cutting-edge voice generation and recognition capabilities make it easy to learn real-life dialogues, giving you the confidence you need to speak with native speakers.
•Personalized learning: Our personalized lessons are tailored to your unique needs, ensuring that the information sticks in your long-term memory.
•Hands-free language learning: With Natulang, you can learn a new language without having to constantly look at your phone or tablet. Our voice generation and recognition capabilities allow for hands-free language learning, so you can practice speaking while cooking, exercising, or doing other activities.
•Accessible for blind users: Natulang fully supports VoiceOver, making it an excellent choice for blind and visually impaired users. The app’s speech-centric approach enables effective, immersive language learning without visual interaction.
•Japanese, step by step: Learn hiragana and kanji with tables, flash cards and kanji explanations, show Japanese with furigana or romaji, and practice reading with short stories built from words you've learned.


PLEASE NOTE:

Some of the lessons in this app are free, but you will need a subscription to access all of them. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. Your iTunes account will be charged at the same price for renewal within the 24 hours before the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your Account Settings.

You can manage your subscriptions through your Account Settings after purchase.

Learn languages in a practical, fun, and engaging way every day.

4You turns the content you watch every day into real language lessons. Understand videos with bilingual subtitles and a one-tap dictionary, then improve your listening and speaking skills through Shadowing, Dictation, Cloze exercises, and AI conversations.

More than just learning through videos, 4You helps you build vocabulary, practice speaking, reading, writing, and grammar in one app. Learn English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, and many other languages in a way that matches your interests and learning level.

TURN YOUR FAVORITE VIDEOS INTO LANGUAGE LESSONS
- Choose videos available on 4You, share or upload your own videos
- Watch videos with bilingual subtitles and sentence-by-sentence transcripts
- Look up words, phrases, and sentences instantly with the one-tap dictionary
- Practice Shadowing to improve pronunciation, intonation, and speaking reflexes
- Practice Dictation to improve detailed listening skills
- Practice Cloze exercises to strengthen listening comprehension and vocabulary
- Have AI conversations based on the topics and content from the videos you learn

LEARN AND REVIEW VOCABULARY EFFECTIVELY
- Save words and phrases to your personal vocabulary notebook
- Learn and review vocabulary with flashcards
- Practice vocabulary through different exercises
- Review vocabulary with the Spaced Repetition method

LEARN VOCABULARY THROUGH GAMES WITH WORD GARDEN
- Combine vocabulary learning with gamification to make review less boring and more enjoyable
- Learn vocabulary at every level, from beginner to advanced

PRACTICE SPEAKING WITH AI
- Practice speaking with AI across various topics, from A1 to C2 levels
- Receive feedback on your answers and suggestions to improve your expressions

PRACTICE READING, WRITING & GRAMMAR
- Practice reading through books, articles, and various content based on your interests
- Practice writing with different topics and receive support to improve your expression
- Learn and practice grammar based on your level

A VIBRANT LANGUAGE LEARNING COMMUNITY
- Share learning content and your language learning journey
- Share stories and interact with the community
- Make friends and chat with people who share the same language learning goals
- Exchange knowledge, experiences, and stay motivated together

4You supports learning more than 40 languages, including English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and many more.

Subscription Information
- Length: 1 month, 3 months, 12 months
- Price: $7.99/month, $26.99/3 months, $45.99/12 months
- Terms of Use: https://4you.study/terms

Fluency is hard. Being understood is easier.

You don't need perfect grammar or a perfect accent to be understood. You need practice speaking out loud, without nerves or judgment. Five minutes a day with Kippy is enough to start.

Kippy is your AI speaking partner for real conversations in 10 languages (English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazilian and Portugal), Italian, German and Russian). 

MEET KIPPY, TIPPY AND YAPPY
Three conversation partners with very different personalities. Together, they help you speak the way people actually talk.

▷ Kippy is your friendly guide. He asks about your day, helps when you get stuck, and can explain things in your own language until you're ready.

▷ Tippy is sweet, playful, and always in your corner. She makes speaking practice feel a little less scary.

▷ Yappy is not here to please you. He has opinions and will challenge you, so your practice feels more like a real conversation.


THE ALL-NEW KIPPY
• Bilingual conversations: Explanations in your own language, or speak the learning when you're ready - great for beginners to start speaking a new language right away
• Hands-free voice calls
• State of the art AI models and voices

WHO KIPPY IS FOR
• You freeze when it's time to speak
• You studied a language for years but never got to use it
• You used to speak a language and want it back
• You're just starting and want to speak from day one
• You're getting ready for a trip, an interview or a move abroad

TALK ABOUT ANYTHING
• Talk to the characters like a friend about the things you care about
• 30+ real-life scenarios: ordering food, checking into a hotel, making friends, job interviews
• New conversation topics every day
• Natural, human-like voices

GET HELP WHEN YOU FREEZE UP
• Suggested replies when you're lost for words
• Instant translations
• Pronunciation check on every word
• Grammar check as you speak
• 1000s of set phrases organised into practical phrasebooks
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• A Speech Report after every conversation, with what to practice next
• Track your vocabulary and your streak
• Save your favorite phrases and practice them anytime

WHAT LEARNERS SAY

LANGUAGES YOU CAN PRACTICE
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil or Portugal), Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Mandarin, in Simplified or Traditional characters) and Russian.

Start speaking a new language today!

Questions? Email us: support@kippy.ai
Find out more: www.kippy.ai

leads.description:
The AI-powered fast track to fluency has arrived:

Mad Fluent is the AI-powered language app that gets you speaking from day one. No more practicing random words you'll never use. Learn through real sentences, personalized to your life, with advanced AI characters that sound incredibly real and make practice actually fun. This is language learning rebuilt from scratch for people who want to speak confidently, not collect app streaks.

22 SUPPORTED LANGUAGES:
Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Dutch, Polish, Indonesian, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Thai, Vietnamese, Turkish, Ukrainian

Why Traditional Methods Keep You Stuck:

Most language apps teach through premade lessons with phrases like "The boy eats the apple" or "The train is red." This approach came from academic testing systems designed to evaluate school grades—structured, standardized, and easy to measure. But here's the problem: learning isolated vocabulary in predetermined order is incredibly slow for actual conversation. You can ace every lesson and still freeze when someone asks you a simple question in real life. That's not fluency. That's memorization without application.

The AI Revolution in Language Learning:


Mad Fluent throws out the textbook and teaches you what to actually say in real situations. Learn from DAY ONE the right vocabulary that fits to your goals—whether its joking with bartenders in Madrid, falling in love in Rome, international business meetings, or experiencing a place like a local instead of a tourist.

Three Revolutionary Learning Modes:

CHAT MODE
Ask for any word, phrase, or question and get instant contextual responses with native audio. Every interaction auto-generates flashcards with definitions, example sentences, and native audio playback. Save anything to your personal library. Learn exactly what you need, when you need it.

MEMORIZE MODE 
Swipe through flashcards with intelligent spaced repetition. Swipe right when you've remembered a word, left when you need more practice. The smart learning algorithm intelligently adapts to maximize your longterm memory.

CHARACTER MODE
Practice speaking with AI characters that sound incredibly realistic and have genuine personality. Hold real-time voice conversations, use the shadowing method to perfect pronunciation, and discover new vocabulary naturally through guided practice. Tap any word you hear to instantly save it as a flashcard. Get unlimited speaking practice anywhere, anytime—something impossible with human tutors.

Why Mad Fluent Gets You Fluent Faster:

- Sentence-based learning means you speak in context from day one
- Personalized AI mentors with real personality make practice fun and relevant
- Unlimited speaking practice on your schedule, in your pocket
- Instant flashcard creation from everything you hear or ask
- Personalized content—skip the irrelevant vocabulary, learn what matters to you
- Learn how people really talk, not textbook phrases nobody uses
- Intelligent memorization system that's proven effective and genuinely addictive

Start your fast track to fluency today!

We're working to make Mad Fluent the most useful language app in the world. 
Have any suggestions? Send us your feedback at: contact@thesupermad.com

Privacy Policy: https://www.thesupermad.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.thesupermad.com/terms

source.releaseNotes:
Mad Fluent 3.0 is our biggest update yet, and 3.1 builds on it:

A whole new call experience
Calls run on a brand-new engine with a much smarter AI. Your mentor catches your mistakes, tells you how close you got, and says the line back the right way. Every character sounds even more expressive and realistic than before.

Memory
Your mentors remember what you share in Free Talk, and they share one memory: tell Freddy something, and Jennie knows it too. You can see and delete everything they remember.

Reworked characters
All characters now have more refined identities. Freddy and Pandora speak like locals of the language you're learning, and Jennie serves as the most neutral mentor.

Free Talk
The Characters tab is now Free Talk. You lead the conversation while your character coaches you, with hint cards to help you say your next line.

Achievements & XP
Unlock 30 achievements and earn XP as you practice. Your streak now counts lessons, reviews and calls, and your past progress already counts.

New in 3.1

Immersive mode
A new way to practice for intermediate learners: in Free Talk your mentor can now speak entirely in the language you're learning. A new translate feature lets you see a live translation under every sentence. Choose it for each language you learn in Settings › Call settings.

Improved word breakdown
Tap a sentence or a highlighted phrase to see it word by word. Tap any word for its meaning and dictionary form, and save it to Review.

Faster translations
Translations and highlights now process quicker in every call.

Also new
• Improved Sandbox mode
• Sharper Journey lessons
• A redesigned Settings screen
• Practice reminders at a time you choose
• Call settings: your teaching mode and feedback style in one place
• Improved correction accuracy in Free Talk
• Other fixes and performance improvements

leads.description:
Master Adjectives, Verbs, Prepositions & More With Practical Grammar Practice

Learning English becomes a rewarding experience when grammar is no longer a puzzle. Whether you're refreshing your memory or building a solid foundation from scratch, this app makes mastering adjectives, articles, prepositions, pronouns, and verbs an enjoyable part of your daily routine. Designed for learners of all levels, it's the perfect companion for those diving deeper into grammar rules while keeping things interactive and fun.

Improve Grammar Skills Through Clear Lessons and Real-World Use

The app is built to support users as they learn English through practical application. Complex topics are broken down into easy-to-understand sections, offering insight into sentence construction and proper word usage. With every explanation, examples highlight how grammar works in everyday conversations and writing.

Practice With Interactive Features and Lessons

The grammar section includes a complete guide to essential English grammar, focusing on key parts of speech. Explanations are paired with examples to help users visualize how grammar works. From verbs and articles to pronouns and prepositions, each rule is supported by exceptions to ensure full understanding. To reinforce learning, over 15 types of interactive exercises appear after each topic, giving users a chance to put theory into action.

Grammar comes to life through practical learning features. Tests evaluate understanding across different areas, using texts and books as a foundation. Learners interact with real-world content, inserting the correct words into context-rich sentences. It’s an engaging way to explore how grammar shapes meaning while boosting retention and confidence.

Interactive exercises offer multiple-choice questions focused on sentence structure. Sentences appear with missing adjectives, articles, verbs, pronouns, and prepositions, inviting users to think critically. The answer-checking system provides immediate feedback, helping learners track progress while sharpening their grammar intuition.

Explore the Full Range of English With Confidence

Covering both British and American English, the app supports learners aiming for accuracy across global English standards. It’s especially useful for those preparing for exams like IELTS and TOEFL, offering practice that strengthens both writing and speaking.

The design fits beginners who are just starting their languages course and also supports more advanced users looking to polish their conversation skills. With vocabulary integrated into grammar examples, learners naturally expand their dictionary of usable words, improving pronunciation, listening, and overall speaking skills along the way.

Designed for Every English Learning Journey

Whether used as a standalone tool or alongside a course, the app adds depth to any learning process. It’s suitable for adults picking up English for the first time, learners returning to study after a break, or those aiming to build confidence before relocating or starting a new job. The grammar focus enhances language accuracy, helping users communicate clearly and effectively.

A Fast, Easy, and Complete Way to Learn English

With a structured approach, friendly tone, and interactive tasks, users benefit from a smooth and enjoyable learning journey. Grammar becomes accessible, and progress is visible through active engagement. As you practice daily, confidence grows—and every completed exercise brings you closer to mastering the language.

Support: appsfenls@gmail.com
Terms of use & Privacy policy: https://apps.fenls.com/legacy.html

Banter — AI Language Partners That Remember Your Journey

Learn to speak English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese (Mandarin), Korean, or Italian through real conversations that build over time.
Join tens of thousands of language learners using Banter to practice speaking with an AI conversation partner who actually remembers you — your interests, your goals, and your progress.
No scripted lessons. No resets. Just real speaking practice that evolves with every conversation.

Start Speaking From Day 1
With Banter, you don't study a language — you speak it.
- Talk about your day in your target language
- Practice real-life scenarios: travel, work, casual conversation
- Switch topics naturally mid-conversation
- Build speaking confidence without fear of judgment

The AI Language Partner That Actually Remembers You
What makes Banter different from other language learning apps? Memory.
Your AI conversation partner remembers:
- Every conversation you've had together
- Words and phrases you struggle with
- Your interests, goals, and preferred learning style
- Topics you want to explore
When you mention your upcoming trip to Seoul, they'll ask how it went when you return. Every conversation becomes more personal, more engaging, and more effective at building fluency.

Multiple AI Partners — Different Personalities, Same Language
Choose from AI conversation partners with unique personalities, backstories, and communication styles.
Practice casual small talk with a friendly local. Debate current events with a curious intellectual. Get travel tips from a globetrotter. Work on business language with a professional mentor.

Available in 8 Languages:
English • Spanish • French • German • Japanese • Chinese (Mandarin) • Korean • Italian

Smart Feedback That Doesn't Interrupt Your Flow
Speak freely and naturally. Get personalized help exactly when you need it.
- Ask "How would a native say this?" during any conversation
- Get gentle corrections with natural alternatives
- Tap any message for native pronunciation
- Learn vocabulary and grammar in context, not isolation
- Receive detailed feedback on fluency, grammar, vocab, and engagement

Build Real-World Fluency Through Conversation
Banter helps you develop the skills you actually need to speak confidently:
- Overcome speaking anxiety and think less, speak more
- Practice anytime, anywhere — no scheduling tutors
- Learn phrases you'll actually use in real life
- Improve pronunciation, grammar, and fluency naturally 
- Build lasting confidence for travel, work, and daily conversation
- Progress at your own pace, from beginner to advanced
Whether you're preparing for a trip abroad, advancing your career, connecting with family, or pursuing language mastery — Banter gives you unlimited speaking practice with an AI that grows with you.

How Banter Works:
STEP 1: Choose your AI conversation partner and language
STEP 2: Start talking about anything — your day, your interests, real-life scenarios
STEP 3: Get instant feedback and corrections when you want them
STEP 4: Watch your AI partner remember your journey and conversations deepen over time
The more you speak, the better you get. The more you talk, the more your partner knows you.

Banter Membership
Access Banter for free. Full access requires a subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Your Apple account will be charged within 24 hours prior to renewal. Manage your subscription anytime in your Apple Account Settings.
Privacy Policy:https://banter.world/privacy
Terms of Use: https://banter.world/terms
Contact: hello@banter.world
