leads.description:
Everlog is a calm, private journal for everything worth remembering: your thoughts, photos, places, moods and workouts, together in one place on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Open it and start writing. Everlog stays out of your way while you write, then helps you look back.

Write Without Friction
• A fast, distraction-free editor with Markdown formatting, checklists and highlights
• Templates with fill-in fields for routines like gratitude lists or morning pages
• Writing prompts, plus personal prompt ideas based on your recent entries
• Tags, bookmarks, comments and full search keep everything easy to find

Capture the Whole Day
• Photos, Live Photos and GIFs, inline with your words or in a panel beside them
• Location and weather for every entry
• Songs, podcasts, workouts with their routes, places and moods from Journaling Suggestions
• Voice recordings with automatic transcription, videos, PDFs and sketches

Look Back
• On This Day shows what you wrote on this date in past years
• Recaps sum up every month and year with your photos, stats and a summary written by Apple Intelligence
• Widgets for streaks, writing stats and On This Day help you keep the habit

Private by Design
• Lock Everlog with a passcode, Face ID or Touch ID
• Your entries live on your devices and in your own iCloud, never on our servers
• Encrypt your backups with a key only your devices hold
• Back up to iCloud Drive or a folder of your choice, and export to JSON, PDF, text or CSV at any time

At Home on Every Device
• A full Mac app with multiple windows, menus and keyboard shortcuts
• Designed for iPad, and for iPhone Duo both folded and unfolded
• Shortcuts actions, Lock Screen widgets, Control Center controls and Spotlight search

Bring Your Journal With You
Import from nine other journaling apps, or from Markdown and text files. Your entries keep their dates, and photos and tags come along wherever the other app exports them.

Everlog Premium
Everlog is free to use, with no limit on entries. Premium adds iCloud sync across all your devices, unlimited journals, automatic backups, video, audio, PDFs, sketches, weather, extra fonts and alternate app icons.

Privacy Policy: https://everlog.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://everlog.app/terms

source.releaseNotes:
- Gallery. Switch the timeline to Gallery to see the photos and videos in your entries in a grid, grouped by month, like Photos. Pinch to make them bigger or smaller, and tap one to open its entry
- Map. Switch the timeline to Map to see your entries where you wrote them. Nearby entries share a pin that splits as you zoom in
- Moods. Tap Add Mood in the Attach menu or the new entry button to log how you feel right now or how your day went, and save it to the Health app as State of Mind. With Premium
- Assistants. Let Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or Gemini add entries for you, with photos, tags, a mood and a place, and change the ones they added. Turn it on in Settings › Assistants and follow the steps to connect. With Premium
- New calendar. The timeline's calendar is smaller and cleaner, and each day fills up as you get closer to your daily goal. Tap the month to jump to a date, or turn on Compact Calendar in Timeline settings to keep the month in the navigation bar
- Handoff. Pick up the entry you're writing on your other iPhone, iPad or Mac, right where you left off. The timeline, a search or a recap you're reading hand off too
- Edit many entries at once. Select entries in the timeline and tap Edit Tags to add or remove tags on all of them, or More to pin them, give them a location, copy, export or delete them
- Storage. See how much space Everlog uses on your device and in iCloud, by type and by journal, in Settings › Storage
- Recaps you haven't opened yet show a dot, so you can see which ones are new
- Search Places. In Add Location, places that match appear in a list as you type. Tap one to move the map there
- AI prompt history. Swipe back through the For You prompts you've generated to find one again
- A new bar above the keyboard. Attach, Tag, Format, Undo and Redo sit in one bar, and all formatting moves to the Format panel, now with indentation. Insert Link keeps the keyboard up while you type the address
- Various bug fixes and improvements

leads.description:
Your calendar, as a stack of paper. Every day in Hibi is a soft, textured page you can doodle on, cover in stickers, and make entirely your own, wrapped around a real calendar that quietly keeps up with your life.

Hibi shows your existing calendars and reminders through Apple's built-in system. No account, no sign-up, nothing to set up. Just three views:

• Day: paper cards you tear away with a swipe
• Week: your days in a gentle stream
• Month: one endless, uncluttered grid

Then it hands you the pens:

• Draw and write by hand, with Apple Pencil support on iPad
• Add stickers, or make your own by cutting them straight from your photos
• Choose your paper, ruling, and colour, and arrange each page the way you like

The details are cared for: hand-picked pastel tints for each of your calendars, live weather on every page from Apple Weather, elegant serif type, a proper dark mode, and home-screen widgets for today's page and what's coming next, unlocked with Hibi Plus.

Private by design. No Hibi account or advertising tracking. Your decorated pages sync through your own iCloud. If you choose to share usage analytics, Hibi sends limited feature-use information to our self-hosted analytics service. Your calendar, reminders, and page content are never included in analytics.

No subscription. The core app is free. An optional one-time Hibi Plus unlock adds those home-screen widgets, alternate app icons, a personal rubber stamp for your pages, and interactive reminders in your widgets, yours for life.

Hibi is Japanese for "days." We made it so you'd want to open yours.

leads.app_name: Little Memory: One Line a Day
leads.description:
Tried journaling before? Quit after a week? Little Memory is a journal for people who have a hard time keeping a journal. Write one line about your day, that's it. Fifteen seconds, done.

A week, a month, a year from now, your words come back to you. You'll notice patterns you never expected, see how far you've come, and rediscover moments you would have lost.

Featured in Apple Staff Favorites, Dear Diary, and Apps for Writers.

"A clean, beautiful time machine." — App Store review
"If the idea of keeping a journal is daunting, Little Memory is perfect." — Elite Daily

What if there was a simple way to keep the moments that bring meaning to your life? A chance encounter, a first step, a perfect smile: saved in a quiet space that's all your own, and returned to you later, when you need them most. That's Little Memory.

What you get:
■ Memories resurface on their anniversaries: a week, a month, a year later
■ A morning memory: your own words from a year ago, back on your lock screen
■ Nightly reminders and a streak saver, so a good run never slips away
■ Works with Siri: say "Add a memory in Little Memory" to write one without opening the app
■ Your writing time can count as Mindful Minutes in Apple Health
■ Attach photos and note how each day felt
■ Mark your favorites, share a memory as a beautiful card
■ Streaks and stats that show the days adding up
■ A look back at your week, every Sunday
■ iCloud sync across your devices
■ Wide-screen layout for iPad and iPhone Duo
■ Private by design: your memories live on your device and your personal iCloud
■ Export all your memories anytime

Premium:
■ Calendar: flip through every day you've written
■ Search across all your memories
■ Find memories from Spotlight by what you wrote, the day, or the place
■ Unlimited photos: preserve every detail
■ Widgets: a memory from this day, or a quote, on your Home Screen or Lock Screen
■ Photo grids: arrange a day's photos into a collage
■ Tags: organize your memories your way
■ Location: remember where you were
■ Moon phases: see the moon on each day, and search by it
■ Extended insights: the people, places, and feelings your years are made of
■ Automatic Dropbox backup

"The beauty of Little Memory is that it actually restricts you to short entries so keeping up with your journaling doesn't feel like a chore."

"Oscar Wilde said that our memories are the diaries we carry around with us. I love Oscar, but the diary I carry around with me is the Little Memory."

"A telegraph-style of journal. Evocative."

Questions?
ivan@thelittlememory.com

leads.description:
Riley is where you draw your feelings when words don't quite reach them.

Every day you draw a small orb, and its colour follows your mood. Underneath, if you want, you can drop in a note, a photo, or a short voice memo*. Over time those orbs line up into something that reads like your month, even your year: sometimes a spiral, sometimes a calendar.

Maybe you're working through stress, anxiety, or a low stretch, or maybe you just want a small habit that sticks. Riley gives you a quiet, private corner for it.

Everything you write stays on your device by default, nothing leaves your phone unless you ask it to. Backups and the friends feature are there if you ever want them, entirely optional and always your call.

There are clear charts* too, showing what tends to set you off and what actually helps. The whole thing is built to be structured but gentle, and it works well for ADHD and CBT-style tracking.

Start drawing how you feel today.

*Photo attachments, voice notes, and advanced charts require a subscription.

→ Know what to lift next — your last sets and weights are always right there.

→ Train your way — use the built‑in exercise catalog or create your own to match any program.
→ Share your progress — share your day's lifts, a routine, or progress on an individual exercise.
→ Reliable anywhere — works 100% offline, even in basement gyms.
→ Travel without friction — switch between pounds and kilograms instantly.
→ See real progress — clear charts turn history into actionable insights.
→ Save time every session — create routines once, then log entire workouts quickly.

Lift smarter. Make every session count with Gains.

Gains+ supercharges your workout tracking with features that are available via subscription

→ Unlimited routine creation — The only limit is your imagination
→ Advanced routines — Copy/paste rep schemes, select alternate exercises, organize routines into folders, and more
→ Drag and drop — Drag to reorder your routines within an individual day, or move them to a different day!
→ Set tagging — Tag sets as "warmup", "cooldown", or whatever else you may want
→ Multi-metric logging — Log weight, reps, AND time all in one log. Or log cardio by distance and energy or any other combination
→ Full data export — Export your entire Gains archive as a CSV
→ iCloud Backup — Back up your Gains database redundantly in iCloud
→ Custom accent colors — Choose from one of 10 color themes
→ Custom 1 Rep Max algorithm — Choose from one of many algorithms to estimate your 1 rep max
→ Many more features coming soon!

Download Gains and make every session count.

source.releaseNotes:
This is a big one. Full iPhone Duo support, two highly requested features, and a ton of fixes and improvements

NEW
→ iPhone Duo support: Days, Exercises, Routines and exercise details use the full screen when unfolded.
→ Save as Routine: turn any day's exercises into a routine. Open the Day menu and tap "Save as Routine…". Gains carries over your exercises, sets, reps and tags, and even suggests a name for it.
→ Duplicate routines: tap and hold any routine, or use the routine's menu, to make a copy.
→ Improved automatic exercise suggestions
→ Sort exercises by Date Created
→ Searching for a folder's name now finds the routines inside it.

FIXES
→ Day notes save as you type, so they aren't lost if you leave the app mid-sentence.
→ Fixed crashes when opening old routine logs after the routine was changed.
→ Fixed crashes when opening some shared routine links.
→ Fixed a crash when picking a custom chart date range.
→ Deleting exercises from the exercise list now asks for confirmation first.
→ Tagging a set in a super set no longer overwrites the other exercises' sets.
→ Personal records are more accurate, and update properly after you edit a log.
→ Estimated 1RM no longer shows nonsense values for very high rep sets.
→ Pausing the rest timer from the Lock Screen no longer restarts it.
→ Rest timer notifications fire on time.
→ Decimals like "1,5" are read correctly in languages that use a comma.
→ Fixed wrong dates for people using Buddhist, Japanese and other non-Gregorian calendars.
→ Your unit choices no longer reset before you log your first exercise.
→ iCloud backup keeps your previous backup until the new one is finished.
→ Gains+ is recognized more reliably.
→ Saving a log is faster for exercises with a long history.
→ Lots of smaller fixes and polish.

Zeno is the simple app for people who want to train, eat and move well — without drowning in research, apps and $100 subscriptions.

Plan and log your workouts. Track your calories and macros. Build a daily stretching habit. All in one app. Free forever plan.

WHAT YOU GET

STRENGTH TRAINING

Custom workout programs, built around you.

- Tell Zeno your equipment, schedule, goals and even your injuries. It builds the plan.
- Know exactly what to lift — every set, every rep.
- Weights go up automatically as you get stronger. Progressive overload, handled.
- Log every set, rep and workout. Watch the numbers climb.
- Learn proper form with 3D demonstrations you can rotate and zoom.

CALORIE TRACKING

Track your calories and macros without the obsession.

- Search foods or scan a barcode.
- See your calories, protein, carbs and fat at a glance.
- Built to support your training, not take over your life.

FLEXIBILITY

Loosen up and move better.

- Follow guided stretching routines.
- Target the areas that need it.
- A few minutes a day is enough.

WHY ZENO

Every level, from your first session on. Most apps assume you already know what you're doing. Zeno meets you where you are — beginner to advanced.

Nothing to decide. Open the app. It tells you what to do today.

One app, not five. Training, nutrition and mobility in one place.

Free forever plan. No ads. No credit card. Premium is there if you want more, never a trap.

Most workout apps cost over $100 a year. Zeno has a free forever plan.

This app won't change your life. You will.

Start today.

Is Zeno really free?
Yes. The free forever plan gives you real, usable training, tracking and flexibility — no credit card, no trial countdown. Upgrade only if you want more.

Do I need any experience?
No. Choose beginner, intermediate or advanced. Zeno meets you where you are and progresses as you improve.

Is this just a habit tracker?
It's more than a tracker. Zeno builds your plan, tells you what to do, and adjusts as you go — from your first session to your hundredth.

Blumy learns your baby's rhythm and tells you the right time for the next nap. Log feeds, diapers and sleep in one tap, and Blumy shows you what's coming next.

More than 200,000 families use Blumy to sleep better, organize their baby's routine and keep up with every milestone.

BABY SLEEP, RIGHT ON TIME
• Next nap and bedtime predictions based on your baby's age and real routine, not a generic chart
• A daily sleep schedule that adjusts when your baby wakes up earlier or later than expected
• Day and night sleep reports: total sleep, night wakings and longest stretch
• The more you log, the sharper the predictions get

A ROUTINE WITHOUT THE MENTAL LOAD
• Breastfeeding with side and duration, bottles, pumping, diapers, baths and more, all in one tap
• Timers for feeds and naps
• A diary that shows the week's patterns, so you can see what's changing

DAILY INSIGHTS
• Every day Blumy reads your logs and shows what matters: the next nap window, last night's summary and the milestones coming up
• Understand your baby's day in seconds, no mental math

DEVELOPMENT, MILESTONES AND LEAPS
• Expected milestones for each stage, with the age range for each one
• Developmental leaps explained, so behavior changes make sense
• Play ideas and video activities for every stage

BLU, YOUR AI ASSISTANT
• Ask about sleep, feeding and development anytime, even at 3 a.m.
• Blu knows your baby's history and answers based on it, not with generic advice

CARE TOGETHER
• Share access with everyone who helps, like your partner, grandparents or nanny: they see new logs right away
• Track more than one child in the same app

WHO IT'S FOR
Moms and dads of newborns, babies and toddlers up to 3 years old, especially first-time parents who want fewer doubts and calmer days.

Blumy helps you organize and understand your baby's routine. It does not replace professional advice.

SUBSCRIPTION
Full features are part of Blumy Pro: unlimited logs, sleep plan and predictions, milestones and leaps, family sharing, more than one child and unlimited Blu. Try it free for 7 days. You're only charged when the trial ends, and you can cancel anytime in your iPhone Settings.

You know what you want to do. Mom Clock helps you actually do it.

Build routines, stay focused, and spend less time scrolling with a little structure and encouragement when you need it most.

Maybe you want to wake up earlier, study without checking your phone, exercise more often, or stop putting things off until tomorrow. You don't need to change everything at once. You just need a way to keep showing up for what matters.

Mom Clock brings daily routines, app blocking, focus sessions, and progress insights together in one place. Make a small promise to yourself, create room to follow through, and see how your days begin to change.

BUILD ROUTINES THAT FIT YOUR LIFE

Good habits begin with small actions you can repeat. Create routines for the things you want to do more consistently, without building a complicated schedule.

• Plan everyday activities like reading, studying, exercise, and bedtime
• Organize routines around your morning, day, or evening
• Add reminders for the moments when it's easy to forget or delay
• Keep track of the promises you make to yourself

Some routines need a specific time. Others just need a place in your day. Make a plan that works for you, not the other way around.

BLOCK DISTRACTIONS, NOT YOUR LIFE

A quick check of social media can turn into half an hour of scrolling. Create healthier boundaries with the apps that pull you away from your plans.

• Block selected distracting apps during the times you choose
• Set blocking schedules for study, work, or personal routines
• Use app limits to help manage daily screen time
• Review your usage and understand where your time goes

You're in charge of which apps you limit and when. The goal isn't to stop using your phone. It's to use it more intentionally.

FOCUS ON WHAT'S IN FRONT OF YOU

It's easier to begin when you make space for one thing at a time. Whether you're preparing for an exam, finishing an assignment, or working on a personal project, Mom Clock helps you get started and stay present.

• Start a dedicated focus session when it's time to work
• Reduce the temptation to switch to distracting apps
• Give important tasks your attention, one session at a time
• Come back and focus again whenever you're ready

A productive day doesn't have to be perfect. One meaningful session still counts.

GET REMINDERS THAT HELP YOU FOLLOW THROUGH

Plans are easy to make and easy to forget. Mom Clock started with a simple idea: important reminders should be hard to overlook.

Choose reminders for the routines that need an extra push. When a quiet notification isn't enough, an optional alarm can help you notice that it's time to act. You stay in control of your schedule and reminders.

UNDERSTAND YOUR PROGRESS

Improvement isn't always obvious from one day to the next. Look back at your routines, focus activity, and screen time to better understand your patterns.

• See how consistently you're following your routines
• Reflect on time spent focusing
• Notice screen time habits you'd like to change
• Recognize small wins along the way

FOR STUDY, WORK, AND EVERYDAY LIFE

Use Mom Clock to build a better morning routine, study with fewer interruptions, limit late-night scrolling, make time for reading, or simply stop postponing that one important task. Start with one promise. Add more when you're ready.

PROGRESS, NOT PERFECTION

You don't need another complicated productivity system. You need a little structure, fewer distractions, and a way to make the next good choice easier.

Some days won't go to plan. That's part of being human. What matters is coming back.

Start small. Keep going. Make yourself proud.

leads.description:
Bench Gym Log is a workout tracker built for lifters. Log your sets, create workout routines, track your training goals, and turn your workout logs into useful insights. 

Log Your Workouts
Follow a saved workout routine or start an empty workout and add exercises as you go. Record weight and reps, add notes, and access previous sessions and exercise stats while you train. Time your rest periods with a built-in rest timer that runs in the background and notifies you when it's time for your next set!

Build Custom Workout Routines
Choose from our catalog of 400+ exercises, or create your own custom exercises and start tracking your progress. Bench supports weighted, bodyweight, timed, and cardio exercises. Arrange your exercises, set up your sets and rest times, and save routines for your next session. You can publish your workout routines or keep them private.

See Your Progress
Bench automatically generates detailed strength and volume charts for every exercise you log. Explore your progression and training totals across different timeframes. See how your volume is distributed across exercises and muscle groups so you can identify neglected areas and train with intention.

Set Goals That Matter to You
Set targets for workout frequency, strength, exercise variety, or training volume. Whether you want to address lagging muscle groups or hit a strength target on a specific lift, Bench lets you track your progress toward the habits and milestones that matter to you.

View Your Workout Logs
Find past sessions in calendar or list view and review your sets, reps, and notes at any time. You can even add missed workouts and edit past workout logs, so you can fill in missed sessions and ensure all your stats are accurate.

Discover and Share
Explore public routines, save a copy, and adapt them to your training. Share public workouts and profiles with one simple link that anyone can view. In Bench's chat, send routines, exercises, completed workout logs, and profiles to your friends or coach. 

One Account For Mobile and Web
Sign in at app.benchgymlog.com with the same account you use on mobile. Review your history, build routines, and explore your progress on a larger screen.

Free to Use
Log unlimited workouts, view your entire history, and access exercise stats across all timeframes, including multi-rep maxes for weighted exercises for free. Most lifters can get everything they need without upgrading. 

Questions or ideas? Email help@benchgymlog.com.
Privacy Policy: https://benchgymlog.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://benchgymlog.com/terms-and-conditions

leads.description:
A feature-rich QR and barcode scanner: scan, generate, and share codes — fast and privately.

Scan codes with text, links, contacts, emails, locations, Wi‑Fi networks, product barcodes, and more.

When you scan a code, the app acts on it intelligently: links open in the browser, email addresses let you compose a message quickly, and vCards can be viewed or added to Contacts.

You can read codes with the camera or generate them in the app — plus use action extensions to scan or create codes from other apps.¹

Spotted a QR code in a photo or on a website? Use the Read Code extension to scan it instantly.¹

Main features

• Scan with the camera — text, links, contacts, emails, product barcodes, Wi‑Fi, and more
• Read QR codes and 1‑D barcodes from images with the Read Code extension¹
• Product barcodes can open relevant web pages or Amazon (configurable in Settings)
• Generate QR codes and 1‑D barcodes
• Create codes from text, links, contacts, email, SMS, phone numbers, and Wi‑Fi
• Join Wi‑Fi networks automatically from a scanned code
• Scan and save multiple codes in one session
• Generate a code from text, a link, or a contact with the Generate QR extension¹
• Smooth up to 60fps scanner preview with optical image stabilization and zoom (including optical 2× zoom on iPhones with dual cameras)
• Optionally copy scanned content to the clipboard automatically
• Option to prefer HTTPS and avoid insecure websites
• Recents for scanned and generated codes, with search and filters
• Custom QR colors — two‑finger tap on the image or use the menu when viewing a code
• Share any barcode
• Custom URL scheme to generate QR codes from a URL or text²
• Widgets for recent codes and quick access to the scanner

Code Reader Pro

Upgrade to Code Reader Pro for advanced tools — no ads, and your data stays on your device. Choose monthly, yearly, or a one‑time lifetime unlock.

Pro includes:

• Batch scan — read many codes from photos or PDFs at once
• Export & import history — back up or move your scan library (CSV/JSON)
• Custom names — label scans so you can find them quickly
• Starred scans — pin important codes and filter your history
• Notes — add context to any saved scan
• QR codes with logo — embed your brand in generated codes
• High‑res & PDF export — share sharp QR images and PDFs
• Link safety warnings — alerts for suspicious links (IP addresses, punycode, mixed scripts, and more) before you open them

Restore purchases anytime from the Pro screen.

¹ The extension might need to be enabled manually: open the share menu, tap More at the bottom, and turn on the app extensions (Activities).
² Try it in a browser or messaging app: add generateqr:// before a URL or text to open the app and generate a QR code image.

- Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- Privacy Policy:

At OneTap, our mission is to reinvent how we share content and utilize the keyboard on our iOS devices. OneTap Keyboard elevates your iOS experience with innovative OneTap Keyboard Shortcuts, transforming how you interact with your device.

What are OneTap Keyboard Shortcuts?

OneTap Keyboard Shortcuts empower you to use ChatGPT, share specific photos, links, text phrases, and files directly from your keyboard. Simply download the OneTap App, add OneTap's Keyboard to your device's keyboard settings, and create your custom Keyboard Shortcuts within the app. These shortcuts are instantly available on your keyboard, making sharing content seamless and efficient.

OneTap also has a Clipboard feature, which you access right from your keyboard. Anything you manually copy will show up on this tab and is available to copy again whenever you need to. You can long press on a piece of content on the Clipboard that you want to turn into a OneTap shortcut so that you can copy & paste that content even faster. 

Features:
- Share photos, links, files, or text phrases from your keyboard with OneTap Keyboard Shortcuts.
- Clipboard quickly copy the content you’ve already copied previously. 
- Use ChatGPT4 directly from your keyboard with OneTap AI Keyboard Shortcut.
- Create folders to organize your keyboard shortcuts.
- Share folders with friends or colleagues, giving them access to your shortcuts.
- Integrate OneTap into Siri Shortcuts for enhanced productivity.
- OneTap is compatible with all iOS devices.

Access OneTap's Keyboard by tapping the world icon on the bottom left of your keyboard. Here, you'll find all your custom shortcuts along with the ChatGPT shortcut. Tap on any shortcut to use it instantly.

Transform your keyboard into a powerful tool for productivity and communication. Share content effortlessly, use ChatGPT anytime, and keep your favorite items just OneTap away. No more searching for your resume, favorite photo, or important links. Everything you need is now within reach.

leads.description:
step into sound

Odio is an Apple Design Award-winning spatial soundscape app that turns sound into a place you can enter.

Settle into a soundscape as it was composed, or move its individual sounds to shape how it surrounds you. Place rain behind you, move a pulsing synth to your left, or let ocean waves settle across the room.

With supported AirPods or Beats, Dynamic Head Tracking keeps the soundstage in place as you turn your head. The environment feels fixed around you rather than locked inside your headphones.

artist-made audiovisual worlds

Explore spatial albums built from tranquil nature recordings, ambient textures, rich synth compositions, and original visual work. Each album is created as a place to enter, with sound and image forming an atmosphere you can settle into.

Odio is completely independent and works with sound and visual artists from around the world. We don’t use AI-generated catalog content: every visual and 3D audio soundscape is made by artists.

listen your way

Odio rewards attention without demanding it. Listen closely and explore every spatial detail, reshape the soundstage to make it personal, or let the composition settle into the background.

Find soundscapes for deep work, meditation, winding down, quiet mornings, late nights, or simply experiencing sound in a different way.

create with composer

Composer gives you a spatial soundstage for your own audio. Import sounds from your favorite DAW or record directly in Odio, then trim, preview, and arrange them in space. Share your finished soundscapes with others.

Odio includes a curated selection of soundscapes to explore right away, with new artist-made albums released throughout the year.

---

Create Your Own Atmosphere with Soundscaper
Build personalized soundscapes for sleep, focus, meditation, yoga, or a quiet moment in your day. Explore a growing library of over 100 sounds, from gentle rain and ocean waves to forest ambience, instruments, animals, white noise, pink noise, and brown noise.

Make Every Sound Your Own
Combine sounds and adjust their individual volumes to create an atmosphere that suits you. Fine-tune start delays, repetitions, and pauses. Change playback speed and pitch, and position sounds in 3D space for a more immersive listening experience.

Create Your Own Thunderstorm
Add a customizable thunderstorm to your mix. Adjust thunder frequency and distance, or vary the distance randomly. Enable optional flashlight effects and haptic feedback on supported devices. Save your thunder settings as part of your soundscape.

Set a Sleep Timer
Let your soundscape accompany you as you unwind or concentrate, then pause playback automatically when the timer ends.

Save, Edit, and Sync
Save your favorite combinations and return to them whenever you like. Edit existing soundscapes, adjust their sounds and settings, and sync your saved creations across your devices using iCloud.

Fit Soundscaper into Your Routine
Use Siri and Shortcuts to play or pause your current sounds.

Discover More Sounds
The sound library keeps growing, bringing new ways to shape your atmosphere and explore different combinations.

Unlock More with Premium
Start with a selection of free sounds and a timer of up to 10 minutes. Premium unlocks all currently available sounds, saving and editing your own soundscapes, iCloud sync, 3D positioning, longer timers, and expanded thunderstorm settings. Choose a one-time purchase or an optional subscription.

Rain on the window, a steady fan, deep brown noise or a soft lullaby: NoiseZ has more than 100 calming sounds for bedtime, naps, focus and quiet evenings, and keeps playing while you use other apps or lock your iPhone.

New: playlists for the whole night
A playlist moves from one sound to the next with slow crossfades, so the night can change without waking you. Start with Fall Asleep Fast, Baby Nap or Focus for Busy Minds.
- Evolving soundscapes such as Shifting Rain, Fireside and Dawn Birds drift and change, so no two nights sound quite the same.
- Night Drift plays the night in gentle chapters, from Dusk to a Dawn of birdsong that ends as your Gentle Wake alarm rings.
- Guided sessions offer a short, narrated pause, a body scan or quiet company if you wake in the night.
- On Apple Watch, pause, start your usual or a playlist and set the timer. If you choose, gentle taps on your wrist can wake you in light sleep near your alarm.
- Fall asleep together: share a link, and someone far away hears the same sound in step with you.
- A Parent's Voice: record a lullaby or goodnight once, and NoiseZ plays it softly over a calm sound. It stays on your device.

Sounds for every kind of night
- Rain, thunderstorms, ocean waves, rivers and waterfalls
- Electric, ceiling and exhaust fans, air conditioner, hair dryer and vacuum
- Crackling campfire, forest, birds, crickets and wind
- Train, airplane cabin, city night, heartbeat and cat purring

Shape your own noise
The Mixer makes white, pink, brown, gray, green, blue and violet noise live on your iPhone, so there's no loop to hear. Open it from Home, start from a preset like Deep Sleep or Nursery, then shape it with tone and waves.

Make it yours
- Soften any sound: compare gentler versions and adjust its tone.
- Mix up to three sounds free, or a main sound, five layers and noise with NoiseZ Plus. Save your mixes and make one your usual, ready in one tap with Play my usual on the Tonight card.

Choose how the night ends
The sleep timer can fade out and stop, lower the volume and keep playing until morning, or play all night. A dim bedside clock stays easy on sleepy eyes.

Gentle bedtime tools
- Sleep stories and body scans, narrated in 17 languages and played entirely on your device.
- Wind Down guides a few slow breaths while your sound keeps playing.
- Faraway Weather plays tonight's weather from a place you love.

No account needed. With NoiseZ Plus, your favorites and mixes can follow you to your other devices with iCloud.

Some sounds, playlists and sessions are available without a subscription, and eligible listeners without NoiseZ Plus may see ads from Google AdMob. NoiseZ Plus unlocks premium sounds, lullabies, playlists, soundscapes and guided sessions, bigger mixes, noise shaping, Tuned Noise, Gentle Wake, widgets, Siri and iCloud sync, the Sleep Lab in Explore and Insights in You, and removes ads. A sound you play while it is free stays free for you on every device signed in to your Apple Account. You can share NoiseZ Plus with up to five family members through Family Sharing. Choose yearly, which starts with a one-week free trial for new subscribers, or monthly. Plans are sold through Apple in-app purchases; billing periods and local prices appear before you confirm. NoiseZ can remind you two days before a free trial ends. Restore purchases, manage a subscription or ask Apple for a refund from the app menu.

Our ad rules
- No ad interrupts a playing sound or appears on Now Playing, the bedside clock, breathing or guided sessions.
- No full-screen ads from 10 pm to 6 am or during your evening wind-down.
- No ads at all with NoiseZ Plus.

Rain on the window, a steady fan, deep brown noise or a soft lullaby: NoiseZ has more than 100 calming sounds for bedtime, naps, focus and quiet evenings, and keeps playing while you use other apps or lock your iPhone.

New: playlists for the whole night
A playlist moves from one sound to the next with slow crossfades, so the night can change without waking you. Start with Fall Asleep Fast, Baby Nap or Focus for Busy Minds.
- Evolving soundscapes such as Shifting Rain, Fireside and Dawn Birds drift and change, so no two nights sound quite the same.
- Night Drift plays the night in gentle chapters, from Dusk to a Dawn of birdsong that ends as your Gentle Wake alarm rings.
- Guided sessions offer a short, narrated pause, a body scan or quiet company if you wake in the night.
- On Apple Watch, pause, start your usual or a playlist and set the timer. If you choose, gentle taps on your wrist can wake you in light sleep near your alarm.
- Fall asleep together: share a link, and someone far away hears the same sound in step with you.
- A Parent's Voice: record a lullaby or goodnight once, and NoiseZ plays it softly over a calm sound. It stays on your device.

Sounds for every kind of night
- Rain, thunderstorms, ocean waves, rivers and waterfalls
- Electric, ceiling and exhaust fans, air conditioner, hair dryer and vacuum
- Crackling campfire, forest, birds, crickets and wind
- Train, airplane cabin, city night, heartbeat and cat purring

Shape your own noise
The Mixer makes white, pink, brown, gray, green, blue and violet noise live on your iPhone, so there's no loop to hear. Open it from Home, start from a preset like Deep Sleep or Nursery, then shape it with tone and waves.

Make it yours
- Soften any sound: compare gentler versions and adjust its tone.
- Mix up to three sounds free, or a main sound, five layers and noise with NoiseZ Plus. Save your mixes and make one your usual, ready in one tap with Play my usual on the Tonight card.

Choose how the night ends
The sleep timer can fade out and stop, lower the volume and keep playing until morning, or play all night. A dim bedside clock stays easy on sleepy eyes.

Gentle bedtime tools
- Sleep stories and body scans, narrated in 17 languages and played entirely on your device.
- Wind Down guides a few slow breaths while your sound keeps playing.
- Faraway Weather plays tonight's weather from a place you love.

No account needed. With NoiseZ Plus, your favorites and mixes can follow you to your other devices with iCloud.

Some sounds, playlists and sessions are available without a subscription, and eligible listeners without NoiseZ Plus may see ads from Google AdMob. NoiseZ Plus unlocks premium sounds, lullabies, playlists, soundscapes and guided sessions, bigger mixes, noise shaping, Tuned Noise, Gentle Wake, widgets, Siri and iCloud sync, the Sleep Lab in Explore and Insights in You, and removes ads. A sound you play while it is free stays free for you on every device signed in to your Apple Account. You can share NoiseZ Plus with up to five family members through Family Sharing. Choose yearly, which starts with a one-week free trial for new subscribers, or monthly. Plans are sold through Apple in-app purchases; billing periods and local prices appear before you confirm. NoiseZ can remind you two days before a free trial ends. Restore purchases, manage a subscription or ask Apple for a refund from the app menu.

Our ad rules
- No ad interrupts a playing sound or appears on Now Playing, the bedside clock, breathing or guided sessions.
- No full-screen ads from 10 pm to 6 am or during your evening wind-down.
- No ads at all with NoiseZ Plus.

Privacy Policy: https://noisez.strawpine.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://noisez.strawpine.com/terms/

Guide cute, wriggly worms into their matching holes and enjoy every smooth, bouncy move.

In Hole in!, every move matters.
Slide each worm into the right hole — but think ahead!
One wrong move can block your path and leave you stuck.

Simple to start, but surprisingly challenging to master.

Why You’ll Love It:

1. Addictive puzzle gameplay – easy to learn, hard to master
2. Fun worm physics – watch them wiggle, bounce, and slide
3. Challenging logic puzzles – test your strategy and timing
4. Fast-paced arcade levels – perfect for quick, relaxing play
5. Creative obstacles – new mechanics keep every level fresh

If you enjoy snake puzzle games, worm games, or relaxing logic puzzles,
Hole In! offers a fresh and satisfying twist on the genre.

Think smart, plan ahead, and solve every puzzle.
Help the worms find their way home — start playing now!

Whether you run trivia nights every week or just want to dominate your next game night, Trivnow makes live trivia faster, smarter, and way more fun. Hosts can create and manage unforgettable events in minutes. Players can join live games, answer in real time, track scores instantly, and compete for league bragging rights and cash prizes.

Why hosts love Trivnow
Create and run live trivia nights with powerful host controls
Choose from multiple question formats including multiple choice, free response, matching, ranking, and more
Use automatic scoring, speed bonuses, wagering, and special rewards to keep every round exciting
Schedule recurring events, clone past shows, and manage multiple venues with ease
Access AI-powered tools and a growing bank of pre-configured trivia content
Assign cohosts, track prizes, and run a more polished show on any screen

Why players love Trivnow
Join live trivia games from your phone with a smooth, mobile-friendly experience
See questions and scores in real time
Play with your team, answer fast, and compete smarter
Discover local hosts and attend league-eligible trivia nights
Climb the leaderboard and compete for monthly cash prizes
Enjoy a more interactive alternative to old-school pen-and-paper trivia

Take trivia to the next level 
Trivnow League connects players and hosts through competitive live trivia. Show up to participating trivia nights, answer tough questions, earn difficulty points, and compete for monthly prizes and national recognition.

From bar trivia and restaurant events to virtual and in-person competitions, Trivnow helps hosts grow and helps players come back for more.

Download Trivnow and turn every trivia night into an event.

TriviaMaker is the #1 custom trivia game creator used by 200,000+ educators, corporate trainers, event hosts, and families in 100+ countries. Create professional quiz games in minutes, no tech skills needed.

7 INTERACTIVE GAME STYLES
Each style transforms the same questions into a completely different experience:
• GRID: Classic Jeopardy-style category board. Teams pick categories, wager points, and compete round by round.
• LIST: Survey Says format with top answer reveals. Players guess the most popular answers.
• TRIVIA: Fast-paced multiple choice rounds with instant scoring. Everyone gets it instantly.
• WHEEL: Spin to reveal questions in random order. The spinning moment creates instant energy. Ideal for parties, fundraisers, and events.
• TICTAC: Classic tic-tac-toe with trivia twists. Adds strategy that keeps students thinking even on others' turns.
• HANGMAN: Word guessing with your custom vocabulary. Great for ESL classes, spelling practice, and vocabulary review.
• FUSION: Combine Grid, Trivia, List, and more into one seamless game.

BUILT FOR EVERY AUDIENCE
FOR TEACHERS & EDUCATORS
Transform review sessions into game shows students actually love. Make test prep engaging. Reinforce learning through play. Track scores automatically.
Perfect for: classroom review, test prep, vocabulary practice, subject reinforcement, formative assessment, bell ringers, exit tickets.

FOR CORPORATE TRAINERS
Boost training retention with interactive quizzes. Onboard new hires with branded trivia. Run icebreakers that actually break ice. Make compliance training people remember.
Perfect for: employee onboarding, product knowledge, team building, conferences, sales kickoffs, company culture events.

FOR EVENT PLANNERS & HOSTS
Host professional trivia nights without hiring a host. Run fundraisers with custom branded games. 

FOR FAMILIES & FRIENDS
Create custom game nights with your own questions. Birthday parties, holiday gatherings, road trips, your quiz show, your rules.

POWERFUL FEATURES 
• AI QUESTION GENERATOR: Type any topic or upload a PDF.
• CROWD MODE: Live multiplayer for 5 to 2,000 players.
• CUSTOM BRANDING: Add your logo, colors, backgrounds, and music to every game.
• SCORE TRACKING: Automatic leaderboards and team scoring across all game styles.
• IMPORT QUESTIONS: Upload from spreadsheet or type manually. One set of questions works across all 7 game styles.

TRUSTED BY THE BEST
Used by teams at Google, Amazon, Stanford, Microsoft, and 200,000+ users worldwide.
4.8 stars from 2,847+ reviews on triviamaker.com.

CREATE YOUR FIRST GAME IN 60 SECONDS
1. Pick a game style
2. Add questions (or let AI generate them)
3. Share the join code and play

IN APP PURCHASE INFORMATION
A "TriviaMaker Premium Account" includes the following features:
Unlimited Games, up to 4 teams per game, up to 16 questions on Feud, 6 categories in GRID, and 4 answers per question on Trivia. 
We currently offer 2 Premium Account purchase options.
1. "Premium Membership - 6 Month Subscription" - This In App Purchase will give you 6 months of Premium features on your account. 
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
2. "Unlock All Features" - This In App Purchase will unlock a Premium Account for life and is not a renewing subscription.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.

leads.description:
Budget app for income, expenses, household budget and finances – MoneyControl.
Keep track of your finances, manage income and expenses, and plan your budget easily and clearly.

MoneyControl is a powerful budget app that has been continuously developed for over 15 years. It focuses on simplicity, clarity and full control over your finances – not more, but also not less.


EASY INCOME & EXPENSE TRACKING

A good budget app must be fast and easy to use. With MoneyControl, you can record income and expenses in just a few seconds – even while on the go:
    •    Add a new income or expense
    •    Enter the amount
    •    Optionally select category, account, person or note
    •    Done

With shortcuts, recurring or frequent expenses can be added even faster with a single tap.


HOUSEHOLD BUDGET & FINANCES AT A GLANCE

MoneyControl helps you plan your household budget and keep your finances under control:
    •    Set personal budgets
    •    Manage recurring income and expenses automatically
    •    Preview upcoming months
    •    Visual charts for income and expenses
    •    Powerful search
    •    Account management and transfers
    •    Flexible financial month settings
    •    CSV export for Excel
    •    Internal backups

Optional extensions allow you to:
    •    Attach receipt photos to expenses
    •    Create, print and share PDF reports


PRIVACY & CONTROL

Your financial data stays under your control. Synchronization is only used if you explicitly activate it.


FREE TO TRY

MoneyControl can be downloaded and tested for free. The free version allows up to 20 entries per month.
A one-time in-app purchase removes this limitation permanently. Extensions are also unlocked with one-time purchases and can be used on all your iOS devices.



Our privacy policy and terms and conditions:
https://primoco.me/info/legal

leads.description:
Budgetum is a budget planner and expense tracker for people who want to plan their money without connecting a bank. Plan a monthly budget or a paycheck to paycheck budget, track spending and bills, and see exactly where your money goes. Everything stays on your phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works fully offline. No account, no email, no bank login
• Your financial data stays on your device. Back it up or export it as CSV any time
• No ads and no subscription. Budgeting is free; Pro is a one-time purchase

PLAN YOUR BUDGET YOUR WAY
• Monthly budgets, payday to payday budgets, or any custom period
• Your own sections and categories, with your colors and icons
• Planned vs. actual for every category, with clear progress bars
• Budget from planned income, or set a fixed budget amount for a month
• Copy last month's plan in one tap

TRACK EXPENSES IN SECONDS
• Add an expense or income in a few taps, with suggestions from your own history
• Favourites: hold + to add a starred transaction in two taps
• Split one receipt into several categories, with item counts
• Checking, credit cards, cash, savings goals and debts, with transfers between accounts

BILLS, SUBSCRIPTIONS AND PAYDAYS
• Recurring transactions for rent, utilities, subscriptions and salary
• See what's coming before it happens, with the net total for each day
• Confirm each bill when it's due, so nothing slips through

UNDERSTAND YOUR SPENDING
• Spending by category, section, account, store, person or tag
• Drill down step by step, for example Vacation › Groceries › Store A
• Trends month by month, compared with last month or last year
• A spending calendar to spot your expensive days
• Desktop Analytics: explore your data on a big screen, privately in your browser

SWITCH IN MINUTES
• Import from YNAB or any CSV file
• Match a bank statement to your transactions to reconcile an account (Pro)
• Tags, saved filters and mass updates keep years of data tidy

FREE AND PRO
Budgets, expense tracking, accounts, analytics, import and export are free. Budgetum Pro is a one-time purchase: unlimited recurring transactions and tags (5 of each are free), bank statement matching, Saved Sets and Budget Sets. It also supports an independent developer.

WHO IT'S FOR
• Anyone moving from a budget spreadsheet, notes or paper
• People who budget paycheck to paycheck or plan every dollar each month
• Students, families, freelancers and anyone who wants a calm, simple money manager
• Anyone who doesn't want to give a budgeting app their bank login

Budgetum is a budget planner, expense tracker, bill tracker and money manager in one, without the clutter. Questions or ideas? Write from More › Report a Problem. Every message is read by the developer.

Budgetum 1.8 brings dozens of improvements to budgeting, analytics and receipts.

BUDGET
• Set a budget amount for any month instead of using planned income, and hide income for that month if you don't need it
• Watch any saved set on Budget with its own plan, for example Vacation or Kids (Pro)

• Star any template and add it in two taps: hold + on Budget or Transactions
• Favourites don't need a repeat schedule

ANALYTICS

RECEIPTS

SAVED SETS (Pro)

MORE
• Merge tags and contacts; merging categories now keeps and adds up their plans
• Change a transaction from expense to income and back
• Hide description suggestions you no longer use
• Bank statement matching: Approve all, and remembered transfers (Pro)
• YNAB import now brings in paychecks as income; CSV import is out of beta
• Recurring shows the net total for each day
• New: Say thanks, an optional tip to support development

Ever wonder what represents the total amount of all your bills between two salaries?

- Set customized reminders to make sure you never miss a payment again.

Budget Planning

Multiple Frequencies

Shared Bill Reminder

leads.description:
All your household bills. All under control.

With My Home Bills, you can organize bills, subscriptions, and payments in one place. Stay on top of due dates, see how your spending changes, and find documents and receipts whenever you need them.

From electricity to Netflix, from building fees to insurance: a clear view of your household expenses, always with you.

ORGANIZE YOUR EXPENSES

Add a bill, choose a category, and enter the amount and due date. Include a note and set up daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly recurring payments.

Use the built-in categories or create your own with custom colors and icons.

SEE WHERE YOUR MONEY GOES

Check your average spending by category and your overall monthly average. Explore charts, compare years, and follow your spending trends over time.

From your household overview to the details of a single bill, get the information you need to understand your expenses and see how your costs change.

STAY AHEAD OF EVERY DUE DATE

View payments in the calendar, check unpaid bills, and receive notifications before they are due.

With widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, useful information is always just a glance away.

BUILD YOUR DIGITAL ARCHIVE

Keep bills and payment receipts together with their details. Scan documents using the built-in scanner or attach photos, screenshots, and PDF files.

Import files from other apps, share documents, or print them whenever you need to. Less paperwork to store, more peace of mind.

KEEP EVERYTHING IN SYNC

Sync your data through iCloud and manage your bills on iPhone and iPad. On iPad, work in split screen and drag images and PDFs straight into the app.

DESIGNED TO MAKE EVERYDAY LIFE EASIER

• Export individual categories as CSV files.
• Add new bills with Siri and Shortcuts on iPhone.
• Use quick actions to access common tasks.
• Protect access with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Enjoy Dark Mode and adjust text size with Dynamic Type.
• Drag and drop images and documents on iPhone and iPad.

Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to the app, where applicable.

BUDGT tells you exactly how much you can spend each day. No complicated spreadsheets, no bank syncing — just a simple daily number that keeps your finances on track.

HOW IT WORKS
Your monthly budget is divided by the remaining days in the month. Spend less today, and tomorrow's budget grows. Overspend, and it shrinks. Simple math that works.

DAILY BUDGET (DAY VIEW)
• See your daily spending limit at a glance
• Color-coded feedback: blue (good), yellow (careful), orange (slow down), red (stop)
• Log expenses in seconds
• Unspent money rolls over to tomorrow

MONTHLY OVERVIEW (MONTH VIEW)
• Track your total monthly spending
• See spending by category in a beautiful pie chart
• Month-end projection shows where you're heading
• Adjust course before it's too late

BUDGET SETUP
• Set up recurring income and expenses once
• Rent, utilities, subscriptions — automatically deducted
• Your daily budget reflects only what you can actually spend

SMART FEATURES
• Savings Mode: Set a savings goal and your daily budget adjusts automatically
• Travel Mode: Enter expenses in foreign currencies with your own exchange rate
• Day Weight: Allocate more budget to weekends or specific days
• Reminders: Gentle nudges to log your spending
• Categories: Organize spending with custom categories
• Notes & Geotagging: Remember what and where you spent

100% PRIVATE
• All data stays on your device
• No cloud sync, no accounts, no tracking
• Works completely offline
• Your finances are nobody's business

SECURITY
• Face ID protection
• PIN code lock option
• Export data as CSV anytime

Since 2013, BUDGT has helped people take control of their daily spending. No gimmicks, no complexity — just a clear answer to "what can I spend today?"

Start your free trial and see the difference a daily budget makes.

“I am a walking testimony that SaverLife works, the program is real, and you DO save.” - Jessica, $5,000 winner from South Carolina.

Join our 500,000+ members who've doubled their savings rate and won $4.5 million*! 

SaverLife is a nonprofit with unique savings challenges that pay out cash rewards to help you accelerate your savings and hit all your goals.
 

What’s in it for me?
Join exclusive savings challenges to win cash prizes for hitting your savings goals. Earn points for saving and making progress toward your goal. Spend your points on scratchers for more chances to win cash and boost your savings. The best part is these challenges and money saving tips help you build a habit. That habit is the key to saving up for a house, a car, an emergency fund, and achieving long-term financial freedom.

Features
-Unique savings challenges with cash rewards
-Points for each time you make progress toward your goal - redeem them for scratchers to win more money
-SaverPerks to take advantage of curated offers that help you save or earn even more money
-A community forum to learn money-saving tips and tricks from fellow savers
-Money 101 articles and quizzes written by certified financial coaches who know firsthand how hard it is to save

Our investors include JP Morgan Chase & Co, the MetLife Foundation, Prudential, and the Intuit Financial Freedom Foundation.

How do I join?

To get started, simply download the best way to save app and connect your bank to create your SaverLife account - that’s it! Signing up takes less than five minutes.

We’re not a bank. We are a nonprofit. We never touch your money - we only monitor your saving progress to help you maximize your rewards.

“I thought, ‘How will I save? I don’t have money!’ But SaverLife inspired me to see the importance of saving - even a little bit. That transformation in my mind of why it was important was really helpful.” - Shari, a mom from California

Unlike Yotta and Digit, we have a variety of unique savings challenges so you don’t get bored while you stay on track.

Why We’re Here
4 out of 10 Americans have less than $400 in savings. We’re on a mission to create the best help-me-save app to ensure everyone - 10 out of 10 people - has $400 or more saved on their way to achieving financial freedom. 

*Savings Rate is based on comparing savings balance changes in the six months before joining SaverLife versus the six months after.

leads.description:
CanGoal, an app that combines aesthetics and talent into a goal-tracking wonder.

Recommended by Apple editors, featured in App Store; a passionate recommendation for work friends and student partners, with numerous positive reviews! It's an app you're worth having.

What features does CanGoal offer?
- Goal tracking
- Schedule checklists
- Fun and engaging "Goal Buddies"
- Focus timers
- Habits, quantification, and everything in between


Why should you try CanGoal?
- Created many task lists and then quickly forgot or overlooked them? CanGoal reshapes your goal-oriented approach, focusing on what you truly want to accomplish.
- Do you find it a bit boring when achieving your goals? Now, you don't have to worry, because here, "CanGoal friends" will accompany and encourage you to complete your goals, just like your best friends.
- With intuitive progress bars and charts, CanGoal helps you visualize your goal progress. This not only gives you a clear view of your completion but also motivates you to keep moving forward.
- Everyone has different goals and habits, and CanGoal offers a wealth of personalized options, allowing you to customize the interface and features according to your preferences and needs. Whether it's color themes, reminder sounds, or task categorization, CanGoal can meet your needs.
- Whether you use CanGoal on your phone, tablet, or computer, it ensures your data is synchronized through iCloud. This way, no matter where you are, you can always access and update your tasks and goals.

CanGoal's commitment:
- No registration required, no personal information collected
- Data synchronization through iCloud, developers do not have access to your data
- We do not place ads within the app.

---

About CanGoal Pro Purchase Instructions:
CanGoal offers an annual subscription plan and a one-time purchase plan.
- You can choose an annual subscription or a one-time purchase plan based on your actual usage.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
- If you subscribe, the subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be identified.
- Users can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in their "Account Settings" after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that part, where applicable.
- Our app can be used normally after the subscription expires, and any unlocked content will remain accessible.


 
Privacy Policy:  https://www.canstudio.top/cangoal/agreements/privacy
Terms of Service:  https://www.canstudio.top/cangoal/agreements/terms

leads.description:
Octopus is a daily planner, to-do list and goal tracker app that helps you organize daily tasks, plan your day, and track your goals in one place. Create task lists, set reminders, build habits, and turn big life goals into a clear daily schedule. With Octopus you plan your day with intention.

BOARDS FOR EVERY WAY YOU PLAN

* Build your planner from boards: To-Do List, Kanban, Week, Table, Time Blocks, Habits, Checklists and Calendar.
* Start from a ready-made template and make it yours: name, colour, grouping and card style.
* Week board shows Monday to Friday at a glance, with a weekend review to finish and plan the next week.
* Share a task board with friends or your team and work on it together.

TWO-WAY SYNC WITH GOOGLE & ICLOUD CALENDARS

* Connect Google Calendar or iCloud Calendar to a calendar board.
* Every change syncs both ways: create, edit or delete an event in Octopus and it updates in your calendar — and back.
* Day, week and month views, just like the calendar apps you know.
* Tap any free slot to add an event, set repeats, and see all your meetings next to your tasks.

DAILY PLANNER & TO-DO LIST

* Plan your day in seconds: tasks, to-dos and checklists in your daily schedule.
* Reminders and recurring tasks so nothing slips through.
* Prioritize with the Eisenhower Matrix — know what's urgent and what can wait.
* Break large tasks into subtasks and work through them in Focus Mode.

TASK MANAGER WITH REMINDERS & CHECKLISTS

* Organize your task list by projects, deadlines, and priorities.
* Break large tasks into simple checklists and subtasks.
* Focus Mode blocks distractions so you complete high-impact tasks first.
* Your tasks and to-do lists sync in real time across phone, tablet, and web.

GOAL TRACKER: SET GOALS AND TRACK PROGRESS

* Set clear goals with proven goal-setting frameworks: SMART, OKR, KPI, GROW, CLEAR.
* Break long-term life goals into actionable daily tasks with the goal planner.
* Track your goals visually with progress insights and milestones.

HABIT TRACKER & DAILY ROUTINE

* Build healthy habits with daily reminders and streaks.
* Turn routines into automatic parts of your daily plan.
* Celebrate milestones as your habits stick.

AI PLANNER ASSISTANT

* Get personalized suggestions to organize tasks and plan your day smarter.
* Type your plans in plain words — AI turns them into scheduled tasks automatically.
* Let AI help you break goals into steps and balance your daily schedule.

HOW OCTOPUS WORKS

1. Capture — add tasks, ideas, and to-dos in seconds, before they slip your mind.
2. Plan — drag tasks into your daily schedule and set priorities for the day.
3. Focus — work through your list one task at a time with Focus Mode.
4. Review — check your progress, adjust goals, and plan tomorrow in minutes.

WHO IS OCTOPUS FOR?

* Professionals who need a reliable task manager and day planner for work.
* Students organizing homework, deadlines, and study checklists.
* Entrepreneurs setting business goals and tracking KPIs.
* Anyone who wants to plan daily tasks, build habits, and achieve life goals.

YOUR DATA, YOUR RULES

* Sync securely across all your devices — pick up right where you left off.
* Your plans and goals are private: no ads, no selling your data.

WHY PEOPLE STAY WITH OCTOPUS

Most planner apps are either too simple (a plain to-do list) or too complex (project management overkill). Octopus hits the sweet spot: powerful enough to manage goals, habits, and projects — simple enough to plan your entire day in two minutes. That's why people who start with Octopus keep planning with it months later.

PLAN YOUR DAY. TRACK YOUR GOALS. GET THINGS DONE.

Octopus combines a daily planner, task manager, goal tracker, and habit builder in one productivity app. Stop juggling separate to-do list apps and goal journals — plan, track, and achieve everything in a single space.

Download Octopus Planner & Goal Tracker and take control of your daily schedule, tasks, and goals today!

BUILD GOOD HABITS
It's easier than ever with our Habit Strength Meter. Stop being demotivated by a broken streak and start focusing on metrics that matter.

QUIT BAD HABITS
A special tracking mode that auto-completes your habits at the end of the day, so you don't have to do it manually.

INTERACTIVE WIDGETS
View and complete your habits right from the home screen. It's super easy and super fast.

DETAILED STATISTICS
Stay on top of your performance with powerful statistics. Progress is what keeps us going.

COLLECTIONS
Stay organized and focused by grouping your habits into categories. Create morning, afternoon, evening, or any custom collection, and it will appear as a filter in your habit list.

CUSTOMIZABLE
Make every habit your own with over 550 custom icons and every color imaginable.

POWERFUL
Feel free to adjust your goals and repeat intervals without affecting your statistics.

RICH TEXT NOTES
Add rich text notes to all your habits. Plan your gym routines, keep track of your reading list, or capture your thoughts.

REMINDERS
Add habit reminders and opt in for morning and evening summaries, so you never miss a thing.

Feel free to contact us anytime at hello@motivatedapp.com

leads.description:
▣ Bear Record is an app that records the regularity of doing something in your study, work or life, to help you reflect on your recent daily life and become a little better. The cute art style and silly bear accompany you to grow up.

▣ Daily Check-in
You can create something you want to track, such as drinking milk tea, reciting words, poop, staying up late, etc. Set your favorite color and icon, select the start date of the record. If you complete this thing today, click on the white bear and it will turn colorful. You can check in multiple times a day, and the bear's ears will show the number of times completed today. Also, long press for more operations, such as view details, edit, reset.

▣ Data View
The record page intuitively displays the complete data of the tracked items in the past two weeks, so you can see at a glance which days it was completed and how many times.
Clicking on a tracking item can view more detailed data. The data for a certain month or year is also clear at a glance.

▣ Manage Tracking Items
If you don't want to continue tracking something for now, you can hide it first on the record item management page, and activate it again anytime. If you don't want it at all, you can choose to delete it.

▣ Focus Mode
Activate Focus Mode to block distractions and concentrate on your work and studies. Set Do Not Disturb times to make every minute more productive. A cute bear will keep you company while you focus, but if you lose concentration, the bear will fall asleep.

▣ Countdown Feature
Never miss an important moment: Use the Countdown feature to record and remind you of all significant events and goals, making it easy to manage your personal and professional schedule. Record how many days until your partner’s birthday, the next holiday, or the next payday. If you set a past date, it functions as a count-up feature, tracking how long it’s been since an event occurred, like how long you've had your phone or how long you've been with your boyfriend.

▣ Easter Eggs
The home page bear will have different states, wait for you to discover.

▣ Contact Us
If you have any questions during use, or want to give us feedback, please feel free to send an email to: vector_z@qq.com

▣ About Bear Frequency PRO Subscription Service

This service is a paid subscription service where you can choose to use it annually or one-time purchase.

PRO (Annual) is a paid subscription service, which means you pay in advance for future subscriptions. Currently you can choose to use this service annually. At the end of each subscription cycle, your subscription will auto-renew by default unless you cancel auto-renewal yourself or we cancel the service.

- Fee:

READY TO QUIT BAD HABITS?
Smoking, vaping, drinking, alcohol, social media, sugar, nail biting & caffeine

READY TO BUILD GOOD HABITS?
Morning routine, exercise, journaling, meditation, reading, hydration, sleep, cold showers, clean diet, stretching, and gratitude.

------
HOW IT WORKS
------
• Add the habits you want to build or break as your daily habit logger
• Check in each morning and evening to keep your routine on track

• Simple enough to open every day. Powerful enough to actually change behavior

AI COACHING
------
• Your personal AI coach app for daily habit tracking and self-improvement
• Get honest daily feedback that meets you where you are, not where you should be
• Reflect on what is working and what is getting in the way
• Behavior change that sticks, because the AI adapts to you
• Turn a missed day into a comeback, not a reason to quit

------
HABIT TRACKING THAT STAYS SIMPLE
------
• A daily routine app that is clear, focused, and easy to maintain
• Use it as your morning routine app to start every day with intention
• Works as your evening routine app to close the day with reflection
• The habit builder built for people who want real results without the complexity
• Track good habits, bad habits, and everything in between in one place

GOALS, DISCIPLINE AND SELF IMPROVEMENT
------
• A goal tracker app for habits that actually matter to you
• Build the self-discipline and mindset that real personal development requires
• Track behavior change over time, not just streaks but lasting growth
• The accountability app that keeps you honest without being harsh
• Small daily actions that compound into the person you are working to become

------
AI JOURNALING AND SMART HABIT TRACKING

• Everything in one place: your habits, your journal, your progress, your coach

------
DESIGNED TO COME BACK TO

• A clean, focused interface built for daily use
• Beautiful by design, so opening it feels like a habit in itself
• No clutter, no gamification, no noise. Just you and your habits

------
IS THIS YOU?

• People working on self-improvement, discipline, or personal development
• Anyone who wants an AI coach app, not just another habit logger
• Anyone who needs accountability without the guilt
• People who have tried other habit tracking apps and stopped showing up

============

Resolve requires a subscription to access all features. Monthly and yearly plans are available, with a free trial for new users. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon purchase.

leads.description:
Tally is a super convenient digital counting app, designed to help you track and record everything in your life, big or small.

Whether you're forming daily habits, logging important events, or managing item quantities, this app can handle it all with ease.

With features like notifications, repeat cycles, charts, and memos, you can track nearly every number in your daily life effortlessly.

# Use Cases

Whether you want to log the number of cigarettes you smoke, track how much coffee you drink each week, or monitor your daily water intake, Tally makes it easy. It’s also perfect for inventory management, foot traffic counting, or even managing classroom tasks and point systems, giving you an effortless way to keep track of all your data.

# Rich Data Insights

Track your events over various timeframes—daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. You can easily view the frequency of events, the number of days since they last occurred, and the intervals in your history. With a wealth of charts, calendar views, and heat maps, your data is clear and easy to understand.

# Key Features

## Quick Recording, Convenient Tracking

With interactive widgets, Shortcut App, URL Scheme, Action Notifications, and Picture-in-Picture counting, tracking is a breeze. Plus, Tally supports Apple Watch, so you can log directly from your watch.

## Custom Cycles, Track Your Key Totals

Support for daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly cycles, along with custom cycles. You can also set the number of completions needed for each cycle, making it easy to track your goals.

## Up to 15 Different Widgets, Tailored to Your Needs

## Group Management

Manage your own or others' tasks, track various life events, form habits, and even manage counters for classrooms or inventory. Tally is versatile and not limited to habit tracking. It supports grouped statistics and various visual charts, making it easy to view data across different groups.

## Comprehensive Visual Reports

Track statistics over daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or all timeframes, with a rich selection of visual charts—bar charts, tables, calendars, line graphs, pie charts, and heat maps.

## No Limit on Number of Entries

The more you add, the more you'll discover just how convenient Tally is, making management a breeze.

## Real-Time iCloud Sync

## Data Security

We always prioritize your data. Not only do we offer iCloud sync, but also local backups to ensure your data is safe. You can also set a privacy lock on the app to protect your information.

---

Privacy Statement: We do not collect any user information, except for data related to bug reports and user experience improvements collected via Google.

If you're enjoying the app, we'd be incredibly grateful if you could leave a positive review. Your feedback means a lot to us! If you have any questions or suggestions, don't hesitate to reach out at iapp605+tally@gmail.com.

Keep track of anything you want to keep an eye on, from habits and chores to symptoms. Chronicling shows how long it's been, how often things happen, and which days and times they tend to happen.

Some things happen every day, like coffee, a walk or your medication. Others come and go: changing the bed sheets, a headache, calling home. Chronicling handles both, so it all lives in one place.

"If you're looking for a flexible approach to tracking events in your life and want to try an app with an excellent, modern design that supports the latest iOS and iPadOS technologies, be sure to give Chronicling a try." - MacStories

LOG IT IN A TAP
- Add events from your Apple Watch, widgets, Control Center, the Lock Screen, Siri and Shortcuts
- Record a number or a note too, such as cups, miles, pages or how you felt
- Automate logging with Shortcuts, from workouts to arriving home

SEE HOW OFTEN, AND WHEN
- Time since last logged, average gap and longest gap for every category
- Heatmaps, charts and trends over weeks, months and years
- Spot patterns by weekday and time of day
- An annual Wrapped to look back at your year

GENTLE REMINDERS
- Time Since Last Event: get a nudge when it's been too long since you last logged something, from a few hours to a few months
- Daily Goal: pick a time of day, and you'll only be notified if you haven't hit that day's goal
- Rolling Goal: aim for a number over the last few days or weeks, with a daily check that only notifies you if you're falling short

YOUR CATEGORIES, YOUR WAY
- Create your own categories with emoji or symbols and your own colors
- Choose the period each category's stats cover
- Organize them into groups and filter by Focus

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
- iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple Vision Pro
- Private iCloud sync between your devices
- Export to CSV or a single-file backup at any time - your data is yours

If you have questions, suggestions or any other feedback, please contact me at support@chroniclingapp.com.

Keep track of anything you want to keep an eye on, from habits and chores to symptoms. Chronicling shows how long it's been, how often things happen, and which days and times they tend to happen.

Some things happen every day, like coffee, a walk or your medication. Others come and go: changing the bed sheets, a headache, calling home. Chronicling handles both, so it all lives in one place.

"If you're looking for a flexible approach to tracking events in your life and want to try an app with an excellent, modern design that supports the latest iOS and iPadOS technologies, be sure to give Chronicling a try." - MacStories

LOG IT IN A TAP
- Add events from your Apple Watch, widgets, Control Center, the Lock Screen, Siri and Shortcuts
- Record a number or a note too, such as cups, miles, pages or how you felt
- Automate logging with Shortcuts, from workouts to arriving home

SEE HOW OFTEN, AND WHEN
- Time since last logged, average gap and longest gap for every category
- Heatmaps, charts and trends over weeks, months and years
- Spot patterns by weekday and time of day
- An annual Wrapped to look back at your year

GENTLE REMINDERS
- Time Since Last Event: get a nudge when it's been too long since you last logged something, from a few hours to a few months
- Daily Goal: pick a time of day, and you'll only be notified if you haven't hit that day's goal
- Rolling Goal: aim for a number over the last few days or weeks, with a daily check that only notifies you if you're falling short

YOUR CATEGORIES, YOUR WAY
- Create your own categories with emoji or symbols and your own colors
- Choose the period each category's stats cover
- Organize them into groups and filter by Focus

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
- iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple Vision Pro
- Private iCloud sync between your devices
- Export to CSV or a single-file backup at any time - your data is yours

If you have questions, suggestions or any other feedback, please contact me at support@chroniclingapp.com.
