Stress, health, and performance tracking, made simple.

Go beyond measuring heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV). Seamlessly bring blood pressure management, burnout prevention, recovery insights, sleep data, workout analysis, and more into your lifestyle.

YOUR PERSONALIZED HEALTH COMPANION

24/7 Cardio and Stress Metrics
Get personalized, round-the-clock insights into your cardiovascular health and stress levels.

Instant Heart Rate and HRV Measurement
Measure your heart rate in 30 seconds and get precise HRV readings using your device's camera. Your HRV is broken down into metrics like Stress, Energy, and Health.

Blood Pressure Management
Monitor your cardiovascular health by easily logging and tracking your blood pressure over time.

Comprehensive Stress Management
• Real-Time Stress Monitoring: Track your stress levels 24/7.
• Personalized Stress Insights: Learn what triggers your stress and how it affects your overall well-being.
• Adaptive Stress Relief: Get breathing exercises and actionable tips based on your current stress level.
• Stress Trend Analysis: See long-term stress patterns and how they relate to your activities and lifestyle.

Burnout and Overtraining Prevention
Get guidance on when to push and when to rest based on your recovery metrics. We help you tell the difference. Our advanced algorithm takes all your key vital metrics into account.

Personalized Workout Analysis (Apple Watch)
Get heart rate zones tailored to your unique physiology, plus cardio output and post-workout recovery metrics to track your fitness progress.

Athlete-Focused Features
• Prevent overtraining with personalized readiness scores.
• Optimize your workouts with adaptive heart rate zones.
• Track detailed metrics like cardio load and recovery scores.

Sleep Quality Tracking (Apple Watch)
• Sleep pattern analysis
• Sleep deficit
• Bed-sleep ratio
• Heart rate, HRV, and respiration rate during sleep
• 5 sleep zones, including regenerative sleep stages, to help you wake up refreshed for peak performance
• AI that detects issues and offers practical guidance

Widgets and Watch Faces
• 50+ health widgets, including HR, HRV, Stress, Calories, Workout, Sleep, and more
• 12+ customizable watch faces

Seamless Apple Health Integration
Sync all your health and fitness data easily across your Apple devices and apps.

User-Friendly Interface
The simple, intuitive interface gives users of all ages a hassle-free experience.

Whether you're an elite athlete pushing your limits or someone working toward good health, this all-in-one companion gives you the metrics to track your health, optimize performance, speed up recovery, and prevent burnout for lasting progress.

Turn your smartphone into a personalized health companion. Know, analyze, and improve your health by making smarter decisions. We help you make a difference.

leads.description:
Yoa is the everything Health app: sleep, recovery, strain, HRV, workouts, daily insights and the small habits that quietly shape how you feel, all in one calm, friendly place.

From restorative sleep and morning readiness to honest training load and the daily choices that move the needle, Yoa transforms your Apple Health data into personalized guidance you can actually use. Whether you're chasing a personal best, getting back on your feet after burnout, or just trying to feel a little better day to day, Yoa helps you train smarter, recover deeper, and finally understand your body without the noise.

Works with everything you already wear. Apple Watch, Garmin, Coros, Whoop, Polar, Withings, Eight Sleep, Pillow, AutoSleep and many more — anything that writes to Apple Health.

FEATURES

Body Score: Your daily readiness, in one number. Yoa combines your sleep, recovery and strain into a single Body Score so you know at a glance whether today is a day to push, hold steady, or take it easy.

Recovery Score: A Whoop-style readiness signal built around your HRV and resting heart rate. Yoa benchmarks every reading against your own personal baseline so you stop comparing yourself to textbook averages and start tracking what is actually normal for you.

Sleep Quality: One clear number for how restored you really are. Yoa analyses your duration, sleep stages, restorative sleep and overall quality, and respects a personal sleep goal so the score reflects what you are aiming for.

Strain Score: See exactly how hard you've worked your body each day. Yoa folds workouts, active calories and effort into a single, honest strain score so you can train hard without burning out.

Health Monitor: A live, glanceable dashboard of the six metrics that matter most: Respiratory Rate, Resting Heart Rate, HRV, Blood Oxygen, Wrist Temperature and Sleep Duration. Each tile is color-coded against your own baseline. Tap any tile for a 10-day chart with your personal safe band drawn in.

Daily Suggestions: Each morning Yoa surfaces a handful of personal observations about you ("In the past 5 nights your respiratory rate was low 3 times", "You missed your sleep goal", "Recovery is trending down") with the data and the action right next to each other.

Smart Journal: Know how life shapes health. Tap the habits that matter to you — caffeine, alcohol, late meals, cold showers, breathwork, creatine, blackout curtains, anything — and Yoa correlates them with your sleep, recovery and HRV over the last 60 days. See the exact % impact each habit has on your body.

Workout Insights: Keep track of your progress. Every workout from your watch shows up automatically with heart rate zones, distance, pace, elevation, full Apple Maps route for outdoor sessions, and a workout strain score so you can see how each session shaped your day.

Past-Day Browsing: Rewind any day in the past and see exactly how your body was doing then. Health Monitor, workouts, scores and graphs all rewind with you.

Apple Watch and Widgets: A full Apple Watch app with complications for every face, plus Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets so your scores are always one glance away. Everything stays in sync between iPhone and Watch, even when your phone is locked.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

1. Processed entirely on your device
2. Never used to train AI models
3. Secured with Apple's Health framework — never on our servers

Yoa works entirely offline once it's set up. No account required.

Terms of Service: http://www.deepblue.si/privacy/terms-of-service.php

Stop getting overwhelmed with long to-do lists. Used by 50,000+ productivity enthusiasts.

Bento is not a to-do list app. It's a focus companion. 

We believe in doing less, and finishing more. Using the calming Japanese themes, stay focused and get things done by packing your focus box. Your focus box is limited to up to 3 tasks. The goal is getting the right things done, not everything. 

Popular with ADHD, everyday users struggling with to-do list apps and overwhelmed individuals who need better focus.  

Start your first focus timer today!

Bento Features 

- Aesthetic Timer: Our Japanese focus scenes are designed for calm and minimalism. 
- Focused Productivity: Limit your focus to up to 3 tasks to help reduce overload and burnout.
- Deep Focus Mode: Block distractions, enter deep work states and stay focused with intention.
- Custom Routines: Start a daily custom routine from your morning routine to deep focus start.
- Focus Booster: Build momentum with your focus & stay engaged as you work.

ADHD is one of our most popular use cases. Helping you to beat task paralysis, support better focus & deep work.

Use Cases

- Study Timer: Perfect for revision and exam preparation. The ultimate timer for study.
- Work Timer: Enter flow states at work by embracing the focus box, focus score & scenes.
- Reducing Burnout: Stop overwhelm by using a calm, low stimulation timer like Bento Focus.
- Neurodiverse Focus: This focus timer is ADHD friendly and popular with the neurodivergent community.
- Pomodoro Lovers: Bento focuses works as a pomodoro timer for entering cycles of focus.

Plus focus badges, app icons, new themes released monthly, focus achievements and unique Japanese focus scenes. 

Bento is for everyone who wants to stay focused and reduce distractions.

leads.description:
Whether you are trying to study, work, sleep, stop doomscrolling, or simply be more present, GetOffYourPhone gives you flexible tools to decide when apps should be available and when they should stay out of the way.

Limit your screen time and start blocking distracting apps in just one tap. You can also schedule recurring focus sessions, create reusable block lists, set daily limits, and review your phone usage over time. Instead of relying on willpower alone, build a system that helps your phone support your day instead of interrupting it.

► START FOCUS FAST!

Need to focus right now? Start a Quick Session in seconds.

- Choose a duration
- Choose which apps to block (or select a reusable block list)
- Pick how many breaks you want available
- Start the session
- Success! You've now begun your focus session.

► SCHEDULE YOUR SCREEN TIME ROUTINES

Build focus into your day automatically with Scheduled Sessions. Block apps & websites at recurring times throughout the day/week.

Create recurring focus windows for work, school, mornings, evenings, sleep, or any routine that needs fewer distractions. Use any of the built in templates (like Morning Focus, Weekend Study, Nightly Wind Down) or create your own that's finely tuned to your exact needs.

► CHOOSE THE RIGHT TYPE OF SESSION

Not every habit needs the same kind of boundary. GetOffYourPhone gives you multiple ways to control app access:

- Quick focus sessions for blocking distractions immediately for a set period of time
- Scheduled sessions for automatic recurring downtime
- Daily open limits for controlling how often app can be opened per day
- Daily time limits for controlling how long apps can be used per day

► TRACK YOUR PROGRESS

Healthy screen time habits are easier to build when you can see your usage patterns and what needs to change.

- Review daily and weekly phone usage trends
- Compare usage between different periods
- Set apps as distracting, neutral, or productive to better access your usage
- Filter reports by device or app type
- Add tags to completed sessions so you can understand what your focus time was spent on
- View all your completed sessions in a clean list

► MAKE BLOCKING FEEL PERSONAL

A blocker should help you pause without feeling cold or generic.

Customize the block shield you see when opening blocked apps with different tones, icons, and messages. Whether you want to see motivational messages, jokes, fun facts, or possibly even want to get roasted, GetOffYourPhone allows you to personalize the shield's appearance so your focus setup feels like it belongs to you.

► STAY AWARE WHILE YOU FOCUS

GetOffYourPhone keeps your active sessions easy to follow.

- View time remaining on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with Live Activities
- Add widgets to start sessions quickly or to check session status at a glance
- View a minimal full screen countdown timer to quickly see the time remaining without touching your phone

► PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your privacy is important to us. We use no analytics, no ads, and have no tracking whatsoever. GetOffYourPhone uses Apple's Screen Time tools to help you select and block apps, categories, and websites on your device. No activity or information is sent to us. Your personal data stays on your device.

► PREMIUM FEATURES

GetOffYourPhone has a ton of features available without paying anything. However, some features shown and listed require Premium. These include Allow Lists, Strict Mode, and some shield tones.

► SUPPORT

Email - GetOffYourPhoneApp@gmail.com
Contact Form - https://getoffyourphone.app/contact/

► TERMS & PRIVACY

Privacy Policy -https://getoffyourphone.app/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA) - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

leads.description:
Time’s Up! is a fun, visual timer that you’ll actually want to use. Whether it’s for you, your kids, or someone else, Time’s Up! will make counting down much more engaging.

Timers can be used at work and at home, whether you’re making sure you take a break or telling kids it’s bedtime.  Timers exist everywhere, but none of them are fun and visually appealing — and that can be important when you’re dealing with kids big and small! Time’s Up! has the features you need to make time fun again — try it for free, NO ADS.

Time’s Up! isn’t just for kids and workaholics, though. The possibilities are endless:

• Adults who need to set timers to stop them from working for too long without a break.
• Kids who don’t want to do their homework but can be convinced to work in smaller chunks.
• Setting reading or other activity timers before bed time.
• Helping bigger kids focus on an activity for a set amount of time.
• Setting timers for exercises — put Time’s Up! on your TV screen using AirPlay and turn a timer into the focal point for your exercise group.
• Anything that’s based on a specific amount of time!

What makes a timer fun? Time’s Up! has 5 fun styles to choose from, including: 

• “Reveal” a photo from your Photo Library as the seconds tick down. 
• “Pixelate” makes a photo more clear as a timer gets closer to completion.
• “Puzzle” breaks a photo into jigsaw puzzle pieces and then puts the pieces into their places as time progresses.

Alternatively, there are more traditional clock faces if you just want a simple timer. Timers can be customized with their own alert sound and color, too.


Other key features include:
• Sync your timers between iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV using iCloud.
• See your timers on your Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, and Apple Watch with Live Activities (requires iOS 18).
• Guided Access to prevent kids from switching apps and changing timers, making sure only you have the power to control time.
• Airplay and tvOS support so you can put a timer up on a TV screen.
• Get audio updates each minute or countdown the last 10 seconds.
• On macOS, you can float the timer window above other apps so it’s always visible.

Time’s Up! is a free download with a trial limit of five countdowns. After that, there is a small one-time purchase that unlocks the app on all your devices, forever.

———————
What’s the difference between “Time’s Up! — Visual Timer” and “Time’s Up! Timer (VPP)”?
You are looking at the free-to-download version of Time’s Up! that lets you try the app five times before upgrading via in-app purchase. “Time’s Up! Timer (VPP)” is the same app but available paid-upfront with no limits in the app itself. “Time’s Up! Timer (VPP)” exists so educators can purchase the app through Apple’s Volume Purchase Program (VPP) for Education.
———————

Time’s Up! has no ads or data trackers. We believe your data is your own and we don’t collect any of it.

leads.description:
Nudge is a focus app that reclaims your wasted phone time. Instead of blocking distracting apps entirely, Nudge lets you use them exactly how you want to.

Need Instagram, TikTok or YouTube for work? Post, reply to messages and check comments in the real apps. If you drift into Reels or Shorts, Nudge nudges you back.

How it works:

1. Choose which apps you want Nudge to help you with
2. Tell Nudge how you want to use your apps (e.g., "No political content" or "Let me reply to Sarah's message" etc.)
3. Nudge detects if you get distracted and gently pulls you away from distraction
4. Use your phone exactly how you want and waste no time

TWO MODES FOR DIFFERENT NEEDS

Task Mode (Pro)
AI detects when you're distracted from your stated goal. Get a gentle nudge to get back on track. No willpower required.

Timer Mode (Free)
Set time limits for each time you use an app. Simple, effective, no AI.

WHY NUDGE IS DIFFERENT

Other blockers limit screen time, which works for a few weeks until it’s too annoying and people give up. Nudge restricts phone use with nuance.

• Not just a blocker (but also a blocker): you can still use your apps, just more mindfully
• Intelligent waiting room designs: the more you use distracting apps, the bigger the friction to access
• AI understands context: scrolling Instagram for a friend's post? That's allowed. Falling down a Reels rabbit hole? You'll get nudged.
• Builds better habits: over time, you'll naturally become more intentional

PERFECT FOR:

• Never checking "just one thing" that turns into an hour
• Stopping to use media that steals your focus
• Those fed up with other basic app blocking solutions
• Creators and anyone who uses social media for work
• Anyone who wants to use their phone, not be used by it

Timer Mode is completely free.

---

Subscription Details:
- Nudge Pro Weekly: $12.99/week
- Nudge Pro Monthly: $19.99/month
- Nudge Pro Annual: $99.99/year (7-day free trial for eligible users)

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.notion.so/Nudge-Privacy-Policy-2ce4f09a055780899d14eb89f5486b50

Take back your attention. One nudge at a time.

App Store 1st place (Pie chart schedule management app ranking in Japan *).
A free schedule management app that manages your daily schedule in a 24-hour pie chart.
Full of functions such as total time calculation and graph transition display.

▼ For daily schedule management and visualization of records to look back on the day ▼
Enter your 24-hour schedule for the next day and have a meaningful day.
With automatic analysis, you can also display the total time and bar graph, so you can look back on the schedule of the day at the end of the day.
You can visualize the wasted time, improve your vague life, and spend a well-balanced day toward your goals.

▼ Full of functions ▼
It is equipped with all the functions necessary for schedule management, such as automatic totaling of total time, display of transitions by bar graph, registration of diary and goals, and remind function by push notification.

▼ Features / Differences from similar apps ▼
[free]
The usage fee is free. (With in-app purchase)

[Schedule registration with 1 tap]
You can easily register an appointment with "1 tap", so scheduling does not take time.

[Pie chart]
The schedule is displayed as a pie chart, so you can visualize the flow of the day.
[Schedule tittle can be freely described]
You can add as many schedules as you like, so you can use them according to your purpose.

[Automatic total time]
Since the total time can be calculated automatically for each schedule, you can immediately see "how many hours you have studied in total".
You can view the total time for breaks and games to improve the way you spend your day when scheduling the next day.

[Transition by bar graph]
You can see the transition for one month on the bar chart.

[List display]
The schedule can be displayed not only in the pie chart but also in the list, so you can check the detailed schedule at a glance.

[Over 100 colors ]
We have more than 100 color variations so that you can choose the color that suits your schedule.

[Time is in 5 minute increments]
Schedules can be registered in 5-minute increments, so detailed schedules can be registered and visualized.

[Notification function]
You can turn on push notifications to receive notifications at the scheduled start time.

[Registration of diary]
You can write down your daily records and hard work as a diary.

[Visualization of goals]
Since you can register goals, you will be able to manage the time to achieve the goals.

▼ Price plan ▼
You can use the basic functions for free without registering for the premium plan, but the free version will display advertisements.

Period: 1 month
Services provided:

・ Priority support is available

・ You can hide advertisements

Arcush is a powerful, minimalistic daily planner app designed to help you organize tasks, boost productivity, manage schedules, and optimize time management. Whether you're planning work, personal errands, or long-term goals, Arcush provides the tools to stay focused, structured, and efficient.

Key Features:

- Time Blocking & Schedule Visualization – Structure your day, allocate time slots for meetings, tasks, and free time, and gain a clear overview of your agenda.
- Task Management & Prioritization – Use the Inbox to jot down ideas, add activities, and organize tasks effectively.
- Inbox Zero – Clear unnecessary tasks, focus on priorities and reduce mental clutter.
- Smart Calendar Sync* – Integrate work and personal calendars for a unified planning experience.
- Time Blocking* – Mark dedicated slots for deep work or important errands, and signal your availability to others.
- Color Coding & Organization* – Categorize and highlight tasks with colors to streamline scheduling.
- Quick Task Creation & Editing – Add tasks with minimal effort using an intuitive interface and a single-screen setup.
- Widgets & Quick Access – Create tasks instantly from your home screen without opening the app.
- Notifications & Smart Reminders – Get timely alerts for upcoming and overdue tasks, ensuring you never miss a plan.
- Recurring Task Automation* – Set up daily, weekly, and monthly tasks with flexible repeat options.

Arcush is designed for task management, time blocking, productivity tracking, goal setting, and daily planning. Whether you're managing work schedules, personal routines, meetings, deadlines, or habits, Arcush helps you stay organized and focused.

Boost efficiency with smart reminders, calendar integration, quick task entry, intuitive scheduling, and flexible recurring task options. With a clean and minimalist planner interface, Arcush simplifies your workflow while keeping your day structured.- Automate recurring tasks with daily, weekly, and monthly scheduling options.

Arcush is free to download and use, with premium features (marked *) available through Arcush Pro, offered as a monthly, yearly, or lifetime subscription.

Expand your planning horizons

Timestripe is a goal planner with flexible time frames. Plan your day, week, month, quarter, year, decade and lifetime side by side, so you always know what to do today and why it matters. We call this system Horizons.

NOW IN 11 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Chinese, Korean and Japanese.

TURN BIG GOALS INTO DAILY STEPS
Break any goal into smaller subgoals and pull it down to a specific day. Rich text notes, tags, colors and recurring goals keep everything in one place.

PLAN YOUR TIME, NOT JUST YOUR TASKS
Schedule goals in the calendar to block time and see how your week really looks. Sync with Google Calendar and Apple Calendar.

ACHIEVE MORE WITH STEP-BY-STEP PROGRAMS
Climbs are guided programs for the goals people struggle with alone: sleep, writing, finance, journaling, mindset. No blank page, just a proven path.

ORGANIZE EVERYTHING ON BOARDS
Projects, reading lists, bucket lists, vision boards, knowledge bases. Start from a community template or build your own, and share any board as a public page.

PLAN TOGETHER
Create separate Spaces for work, personal life or a team. Invite people, assign goals, comment, mention teammates and follow progress together.

AND THE DETAILS
· Home Screen widgets
· Apple Watch app
· Dark mode
· Color labels and hashtags
· Share extension to capture anything
· Public sharing for boards and goals

LOVED BY PLANNERS WORLDWIDE
More than 200,000 people use Timestripe to plan their lives.

Timestripe Pro unlocks every horizon, unlimited boards, Climbs and team features. Monthly and yearly subscriptions are available; prices are shown in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and a subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. leads.description:
Amazing Marvin is a to-do list and daily planner you can customize, one feature at a time.

WHY IT WORKS THIS WAY

Different things work for different people. The method that changed your colleague's life can feel like a straitjacket on you. The setup you loved in March can stop working in June. That is normal.

So Marvin does not hand you a fixed system. Turn on the features you need, and disable the ones you don't. 

What users are saying:
"So customizable, that when I feel I start to get bored, I can change my flow or strategy & it feels like a brand new app."

If you have ever abandoned a setup because you got bored of it, you will love Marvin.

PLANNING YOUR DAY

- Day planner, where each day gets its own list rather than one endless pile
- Duration estimates and a capacity bar that tells you when you have planned more than the day actually holds
- Do dates and due dates kept separate, so "work on it Tuesday" is not the same as "it is due Tuesday"
- Two-way calendar sync
- Week planning, with tasks dragged between days to even out the load
- Nested projects and categories, labels, smart lists, recurring tasks
- A backburner for someday, kept out of sight of today

STARTING IS THE OTHER HALF

Increase your project profits by better measuring and managing your construction crew. Workyard’s construction time tracking software uses the industry’s most precise GPS tracking to create accurate time cards and project cost reports.

Workyard Helps Construction Companies Improve Project Profits

*Eliminate excessive payroll expenses caused by inaccurate time cards.
*Improve accuracy of client billing with automated breakdowns of labor costs for each client.
*Increase crew efficiency by automatically displaying employee labor costs down to the individual task.
*Manage your crew more effectively with scheduling software that consolidates communication about work

Workyard Is Trusted By 1000s Of Contractors To Measure & Manage Their Labor

“GPS location with time is precise and accurate, so I can easily see when people are on site or headed to another location.” John Massarra, Owner, Prestige Flooring

“We’ve been able to track our labor expenses in real-time, with a cost capture that far outpaces what we were previously using. I would predict our client reimbursements will increase by 30% before the end of the year.” Kelly Adreani, General Manager, Earned Run Property Management

“When I tried TSheets the GPS showed me clocking in 3 cities away from where I was at. Workyard is by far the best GPS technology in the industry.” Corey Jeffers, Owner, Deer Creek Construction

“Once you factor in overtime, we’re looking at saving more than $1,500 per employee each year from eliminating those little time reporting mistakes.” Kathi Smith, Vice President, D&S Electric

THE MOST ACCURATE GPS TIME CLOCK FOR CONSTRUCTION

If you're using paper timesheets or a mobile app that shows your workers clocked in three cities away, you can bet you're losing money on payroll. Workyard’s mobile time clock captures precise GPS location, arrival, and departure information to give you confidence that every time card is accurate. 

Most companies say they’re saving up to $2,000 per employee each year by eliminating excess payroll costs caused by time reporting mistakes.

TRACK DRIVING TIME & MILEAGE

Since Workyard switches to super-high accuracy mode when your employees drive, you can count on the mileage we capture to be used in expense reporting.

ADD NOTES, PHOTOS, & RECEIPTS TO TIME CARDS

Workyard helps provide project updates and saves you time collecting paper receipts for expenses by giving your employees the ability to add photos and notes directly to their time cards.

REAL-TIME LABOR COST REPORTS THAT HELP IMPROVE PROFITABILITY

Collect up to 30% more in client invoices. By enabling employees to easily tag hours to projects and tasks using the Workyard app on their phone, you’ll get automated breakdowns of labor costs in actual dollar amounts for every client. All this comes in real-time, so no need to wait until the end of a pay period for valuable data.

INCREASE YOUR CREW’S EFFICIENCY

By automatically displaying your real-time labor costs down to the individual tasks done by each employee, Workyard helps you see how much you’re spending on each of your jobs. Workyard’s up-to-the-minute data helps you gauge if every employee’s time is being used efficiently.

SCHEDULE & COMMUNICATE ABOUT WORK IN ONE APP

Workyard consolidates all communication about your work – including tasks, notes, and photos – into the same app your team uses to track time, so you can more efficiently manage your team.

EASILY FEED YOUR PAYROLL & ACCOUNTING SYSTEMS ACCURATE TIME & COST DATA

With integrations to Quickbooks Desktop, Quickbooks Online, Foundation, ADP, Gusto, Quickbooks Payroll, and Paylocity, Workyard makes it easy to send accurate data to your existing accounting and payroll systems. 

SUPPORT FROM HUMANS

Have questions? We hate waiting on hold struggling to find someone that can help us. That’s why we’ve got a team looking forward to giving you straight answers. Contact help@workyard.com

Combine intervals such as 20 seconds of exercise and 10 seconds of rest, or 25 minutes of focus and a 5-minute break. Set a repeat count for each group.

Find My Device: Phone Tracker

Locate Your Devices Instantly. Lost your headphones, smartwatch, phone, keys, tablet, or any other Bluetooth device? With Find My Device: Phone Tracker, you can track them down in no time. Download now and reclaim your lost items effortlessly.

Introducing Find My Device: Phone Tracker — your ultimate companion for locating Bluetooth devices with ease. Utilizing advanced Bluetooth technology and precise signal detection, this app offers a seamless and intuitive experience for tracking down your devices.

Whether it’s AirPods, an Apple Pencil, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, or any other Bluetooth-enabled gadget, Find My Device: Phone Tracker makes it easy to find your missing items. Simply launch the app and let it guide you to your lost device.

Real-Time Proximity Tracking: Featuring a dynamic radar display, Find My Device: Phone Tracker provides real-time feedback on your Bluetooth device’s proximity. As you move closer, the radar narrows to pinpoint accuracy. If you stray further away, the radar adjusts to keep you on track, ensuring your device is never out of reach.

KEY FEATURES:

•	Accurate Bluetooth Device Detection: Harnesses the power of Bluetooth technology for swift and precise identification of nearby devices.
•	Interactive Radar Display: A visually intuitive radar map guides you as you approach your lost device, offering instant feedback on the distance.
•	User-Friendly Interface: Designed for users of all experience levels, making it simple to locate your Bluetooth devices with just a few taps.
•	Customizable Experience: Adjust radar sensitivity and other settings to personalize your device-finding experience to your preferences.

BENEFITS:

•	Wide Compatibility: Supports a broad range of Apple devices including AirPods, iPhones, iPads, and Apple Watches, covering your entire Apple ecosystem.
•	Precision Tracking: Provides detailed location insights to help you recover misplaced devices effortlessly.
•	Lost Mode: Activate “Lost Mode” for truly missing devices to lock the device and display a custom message, enhancing the chances of recovery.
•	Extensive Bluetooth Range: Detects devices over a wide range, boosting your chances of finding them even at a distance.
•	Proactive Alerts: Receive notifications if you leave a device behind, so you can act quickly.
•	Offline Location Tracking: Even without an internet connection, the app can use Bluetooth signals from nearby Apple devices to help locate your lost item securely and privately.

Whether you’ve misplaced your Bluetooth earphones, lost a Bluetooth tracker, or simply need to locate a valuable Bluetooth-enabled device, Find My Device: Phone Tracker is your go-to solution. Experience peace of mind and convenience like never before. Download now from the App Store and say goodbye to the frustration of lost devices!

Note: The free version may have limitations which are subject to change.

Subscription Details:

•	Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation.
•	Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
•	Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be specified.
•	Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
•	Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited upon subscription purchase, where applicable.

Discover the ultimate tool for sports card and trading card game (TCG) enthusiasts! This app lets you easily scan and identify your sports and TCG cards, providing you with a wealth of information about each card at your fingertips.

Whether you're a collector, trader, or just curious about the value of your cards, this app is designed to make managing your collection simpler and more enjoyable.

AI penpals that feel like native friends. Tutor-level feedback on every single message. That's Sylvi.

You can even pick a penpal with the exact accent you want to have.

French (France and Canada)
Spanish (Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Puerto Rico, etc)
German
Italian
Portuguese (Portugal and Brazil)
English (UK, US, Australia)

More languages coming soon - follow our journey on @sylvi_app

Too shy to talk to a native speaker? Practice with AI penpals who know you well enough to ask about your day. Every message you send is corrected and explained in real time - not just flagged, but actually taught, so when the real moment comes, you're ready for it.

- Learn the phrases you need, for the life you lead

Build your vocabulary by saving words important to you. Test yourself daily to memorise them.

- Stay accountable with friends

Practice with your friends regardless of what language they're learning or what level they're at.

"I've used a lot of different language apps... but Sylvi has been the one I've been having the most success with growth-wise. At least from what my tutor tells me."

Can't bear to lose your streak?

We won't tell. If you've got a streak you can't bear to lose, message us at support@sylvi.ai and we'll transfer it straight to Sylvi.

Try us free for 1 week, then pick a subscription that works for you.

"I know grammar. I know all of these vocabularies, but you're kind of stuck in the middle of like - how do I become comprehensible? Then I found Sylvi" - Amira, UK

"I could say, 'I'm going to the cinema today'. Then if I do Sylvi tomorrow, my penpal will come back and say, 'so what film did you see at the cinema?'. I love the continuity. It's so clever." - James, US

Linguado is a free mobile app that allows you to instantly link with native speakers of the language you desire, by proximity or worldwide. 

A part of our ongoing efforts is to keep our platform secure and fun for everyone. We are a 16+ community of language and culture lovers, but safety is paramount. Please be respectful while conversing with those of all ages, nationalities, and genders.

Use Linguado to connect with people by language, nationality, and location--whether you want to master a new language, virtually explore a new culture or find a nearby friend. It can all be attained by using Linguado.  
 
Get the app to access the full features and functionality of Linguado--anytime, anywhere. 
 
Why Linguado is the best app to practice and learn languages:
 
BOOST YOUR VOCABULARY
For the times when you’re struggling to find the correct words, our in-app translation feature helps you compose a message or translate an incoming one.
 
PERFECT YOUR PRONUNCIATION
Fit in with natives and improve your speaking skills by recording and listening to voice notes.
 
GRASP THE GRAMMAR
Help each other grasp the difficult parts of language learning by correcting one another. The most effective way to better one’s grammar is through language immersion, and conversation with native speakers.
 
LINGUADO YOUR WAY
Forget strict schedules and learning by the book. Embrace your personal language learning style—whether that’s messaging, through voice, or even meeting in person.
 
Why you’ll love using Linguado OR Why you’ll fall in love with Linguado:
Discover new friends based on language, nationality, and/or proximity
Use in-app translation tools to connect and have smoother conversations
Going on a trip? Meet people that share your interests or discover new ones from locals. Or connect with a local to receive helpful tips before arrival.
Can’t travel, but want to? Linguado provides you the next best option by being able to connect with natives in over 200 countries and territories worldwide

YOUR PROFILE
Use “About Me” in your Linguado profile to introduce yourself
Highlight your background, interests, and conversation topics
Add a picture(s) to be seen and help potential Linguado Links find you 
 
 
YOUR COMMUNITY
Language buddies, friends from your home country, and people to collaborate with.
See updates on their activity and reach out via the app to stay in touch
Create lasting relationships.
Your safety is our concern. Linguado does not support, condone, or approve of any types of discrimination, harassment or bullying. Any user who exhibits such behavior will be permanently removed from the app. Our goal is to create a safe learning environment for everyone.

Whether you want to practice a new language, help others learn, make friends while traveling, or if you just need a lightweight way to stay in touch--get started with the Linguado app today.
 
The Linguado app is free to download and use, and it will always be our mission to provide the world with free access to language.
 
Got something on your mind? Contact us at go@linguado.com or chat with our in-app support profile.
 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/linguado/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/golinguado/
Linguado TV: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaoo2LXzS7WGeilBSu57KFw

A part of our ongoing efforts is to keep our platform secure and fun for everyone. We are a 16+ community of language and culture lovers, but safety is paramount. Please be respectful while conversing with those of all ages, nationalities, and genders.

Use Linguado to connect with people by language, nationality, and location--whether you want to master a new language, virtually explore a new culture or find a nearby friend. It can all be attained by using Linguado.  
 
Get the app to access the full features and functionality of Linguado--anytime, anywhere. 
 
Why Linguado is the best app to practice and learn languages:
 
BOOST YOUR VOCABULARY
For the times when you’re struggling to find the correct words, our in-app translation feature helps you compose a message or translate an incoming one.
 
PERFECT YOUR PRONUNCIATION
Fit in with natives and improve your speaking skills by recording and listening to voice notes.
 
GRASP THE GRAMMAR
Help each other grasp the difficult parts of language learning by correcting one another. The most effective way to better one’s grammar is through language immersion, and conversation with native speakers.
 
LINGUADO YOUR WAY
Forget strict schedules and learning by the book. Embrace your personal language learning style—whether that’s messaging, through voice, or even meeting in person.
 
Why you’ll love using Linguado OR Why you’ll fall in love with Linguado:
Discover new friends based on language, nationality, and/or proximity
Use in-app translation tools to connect and have smoother conversations
Going on a trip? Meet people that share your interests or discover new ones from locals. Or connect with a local to receive helpful tips before arrival.
Can’t travel, but want to? Linguado provides you the next best option by being able to connect with natives in over 200 countries and territories worldwide

YOUR PROFILE
Use “About Me” in your Linguado profile to introduce yourself
Highlight your background, interests, and conversation topics
Add a picture(s) to be seen and help potential Linguado Links find you 
 
 
YOUR COMMUNITY
Language buddies, friends from your home country, and people to collaborate with.
See updates on their activity and reach out via the app to stay in touch
Create lasting relationships.
Your safety is our concern. Linguado does not support, condone, or approve of any types of discrimination, harassment or bullying. Any user who exhibits such behavior will be permanently removed from the app. Our goal is to create a safe learning environment for everyone.

Whether you want to practice a new language, help others learn, make friends while traveling, or if you just need a lightweight way to stay in touch--get started with the Linguado app today.
 
The Linguado app is free to download and use, and it will always be our mission to provide the world with free access to language.
 
Got something on your mind? Contact us at go@linguado.com or chat with our in-app support profile.
 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/linguado/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/golinguado/
Linguado TV: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaoo2LXzS7WGeilBSu57KFw

Rozum — Learn a New Language Faster with Spaced Repetition and an AI Tutor.
Create a personal learning plan, learn essential vocabulary, and practice speaking with Linoo, your AI Tutor.

Rozum helps you build a strong vocabulary foundation in multiple languages — starting from the most important everyday words. Whether you’re a beginner or want to strengthen your language skills, Rozum focuses on the words you actually need to understand, speak, and communicate with confidence.

With support for 15 languages, Rozum adapts to your level and helps you progress naturally — from basic words to more advanced, real-life usage.

Why choose Rozum?
Rozum brings together three core parts of language learning and combines them into one personalized learning plan — so you always know what to learn and how to practice.
1. Discover new words
2. Learn them with spaced repetition
3. Practice with the AI Tutor

Who is Rozum for?
Rozum is built for anyone who wants to learn a new language or strengthen their foundation:
— Beginners: Start from scratch with the most essential words and build confidence step by step.
— Travelers: Learn practical vocabulary to communicate easily abroad.
— Professionals & Job Seekers: Improve your language skills for work, relocation, and interviews.
— Language Learners & Enthusiasts: Explore new languages and grow your vocabulary every day.

Privacy policy: https://rockethen.com/apps/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://rockethen.com/apps/terms-of-service.html

leads.description:
Stop memorizing words you'll never use. Start speaking.

VERBI is the language app built around one idea: the fastest path to confidence is speaking, not endless flashcards. Practice real conversations with an AI tutor, learn vocabulary along the way, and track progress across every skill that matters.

Whether you're preparing for travel, an exam, or your next career move, VERBI turns daily practice into real speaking ability.

PRACTICE REAL CONVERSATIONS

Talk out loud with AI voice lessons designed to feel like real life, not a textbook.

• Structured voice curriculum from beginner to advanced • Short themed lessons that teach practical words in context • Checkpoints and conversation capstones to prove what you've learned • Free Roleplay: set any scenario and practice on your terms • Hold to speak sessions with instant AI feedback • Choose your AI voice and personality • Adjustable support from English heavy to target language

FOUR SKILLS. ONE CLEAR PATH.

Speaking: voice lessons and real conversation practice Vocabulary: learn, recall, and retain the words that matter Grammar: verb conjugation and texting in real chat scenarios Listening: scenario based audio at your level

BUILD VOCABULARY THAT STICKS

Swipe through a daily word feed with definitions, example sentences, and pronunciation. Save words, review weak spots, and reinforce through active practice.

MASTER WORDS WITH QUIZZES AND GAMES

• Meaning match, word recall, fill in the gap, and more • Category vocabulary by topic • Slang quizzes for everyday language • Word Search and Crossword using words you've learned

PRACTICE GRAMMAR IN CONTEXT

• Verb conjugation drills for forms and tenses you need • Texting practice in realistic chat scenarios

TRAIN YOUR LISTENING

Listening scenarios from beginner to advanced. Short clips at first, then faster, more natural speech as you level up.

TRACK REAL PROGRESS

See improvement across Speaking, Vocabulary, Grammar, and Listening. Weekly goals, streaks, and skill scores keep you motivated.

STAY CONSISTENT

• Word of the Day home screen widget • Daily streaks and weekly practice goals • Personalized onboarding based on your level and goals • Optional Focus Mode to block distracting apps and earn breaks by practicing (iOS)

LEARN 9 LANGUAGES

Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin Chinese, and Russian.

PERFECT FOR REAL LIFE

Travel, work, school, or personal growth. VERBI teaches practical language you can actually use.

WHAT LEARNERS ARE SAYING

"I finally found an app that gets me talking. The voice lessons feel like practice with a patient tutor."

"I used to memorize words and forget them. Now I learn them in conversation and they stick."

"Free roleplay is my favorite. I practice ordering food, job interviews, whatever I need."

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION*

A VERBI subscription is required to unlock full access to all features and content. If you choose to subscribe, payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off automatic renewal in your iTunes Account Settings.

Your account will be charged upon confirmation of purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.

Terms of Use: https://appverbi.com/terms Privacy Policy: https://appverbi.com/privacy

We love your feedback. Contact support@appverbi.com

leads.description:
How long have you been telling yourself you'll learn English? Spanish? French?

Let's make this the year it actually happens. Not from 400 owl reminders. Not from tapping pictures of fruits and animals. From real conversations — from your very first day.

You'll be speaking with confidence in weeks, not years. Just 10 minutes a day with me.

You speak or type. I match your level in real time. Use your target language, your native language, or a mix of both as you get more comfortable.

MISTAKES ARE WELCOME

It's actually how we learn.

Make all your mistakes with me first. Then you won't have to make them with real people.

When you slip up, I don't shame you. No red Xs. No buzzers. I give you real-time feedback on grammar, pronunciation, and word choice.

I use a three-step method I call the Lily Method: I nudge, then I hint, and only then do I give you the answer.

Learners fix their own mistakes 46% of the time with this method (Lyster & Ranta research). Other apps just feed you the correct answer — so you learn nothing. With me, you learn it because YOU found the answer.

The biggest mistake you can make is being afraid to make one. Duolingo punishes you for mistakes — I reward you for making them.

LET'S TALK ABOUT WHAT YOU LIKE

Whatever you want to talk about — I'm like a friend who happens to speak 50+ languages.

The movie you watched last weekend. Your day at work. The trip you're planning. Your favorite K-drama. The book you can't put down. The song stuck in your head.

Personal conversations stick. Generic lessons don't.

Pack me for the trip. I'll be your travel buddy who already speaks the language.

Want to practice a specific moment — ordering at a Parisian café, checking into a Tokyo hotel, meeting your partner's parents? Just ask me to roleplay it.

I REMEMBER YOU

Other apps forget you the moment you close them. I don't.

I remember the word you stumbled on last Tuesday. I remember your sister's wedding next month. I remember you work in marketing and your dog's name is Bean. Session 100 with me is smarter than session 1 — because I've been paying attention.

You told me in onboarding you have a trip to Italy? Today let's talk about what you're packing. You mentioned you're nervous about a presentation? Walk me through it — I'll help you fix the rough spots.

EARN STREAKS FOR REAL PRACTICE

Streaks earned by real messages, not by tapping a button to keep a number alive. All the motivation. None of the guilt trips. No hearts. No leaderboards. No "you broke your streak!" notifications.

50+ LANGUAGES, NATIVE ACCENTS

English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Russian, Hindi, Turkish, Dutch, Swedish, Polish, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Greek — and 40+ more.

Each with native accent variants (British or American English, Latin American or European Spanish, etc.) — so you sound like you actually live there, not like a textbook.

STOP STUDYING. START SPEAKING.

Babbel scripts you. ChatGPT forgets you. A human tutor costs $30-60 an hour and needs scheduling.

I'm available 24/7. I'm 50× cheaper than a private tutor. I remember every word you've ever said to me. And I'll never make you feel stupid for not knowing something — that's the whole reason you're here.

Five minutes on your coffee break. Thirty on the train home. I fit your day, not the other way around.

Open the app. Say hi. I'll take it from there.

— Lily

Privacy Policy: https://tutorlily.com/privacy

License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

leads.description:
Make practicing fun. Log your practice, connect with a community, rank up on leaderboards, keep a streak alive, and tune without leaving the app.

LOG A SESSION IN SECONDS
Start a live timer, or enter it after the fact. Minutes practised, how it went on a one-to-five scale, what you focused on, and which pieces and scales you touched. Split a long session into warm-up, scales, technique and repertoire.

YOUR REPERTOIRE, TRACKED
Every piece, étude and scale in one place — composer, difficulty, and where it stands. Move finished pieces to Past and keep the history you built.

A REAL TUNER, DRONE AND METRONOME
Chromatic tuner with A4 adjustable from 440 to 445 Hz and an in-tune range you set. A sustained drone on any note to tune against. Metronome from 15 to 360 BPM with custom time signatures, accented downbeats and tap tempo. Audio is analysed on your device — never recorded, never uploaded.

STREAKS AND GOALS THAT FIT
Set a daily target and how many days a week you're aiming for. Miss one and a streak freeze covers you — life happens, and quitting shouldn't be the penalty.

STATS WORTH LOOKING AT
Minutes by week, month and all time. Which pieces are eating your practice, how consistent you've been, and whether this month beat the last one. Weekly and Monthly Wrapped, ready to share.

CLIMB THE RANKS
Six tiers — Student, Prodigy, Professional, Soloist, Virtuoso, Maestro — earned from consistency, scales, repertoire and performances. There is a secret seventh.

FRIENDS, NUDGES AND BATTLES
Add friends, see their sessions in a feed, nudge someone whose streak is slipping, and challenge them to a head-to-head streak battle. Friends and global leaderboards for streak, rank and notes.

46 INSTRUMENTS
Strings, woodwind, brass, keys, guitar family, percussion and voice — violin to euphonium, piano to turntables. Play more than one? Track them all.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your instrument and set a daily target.
2. Practise — start the timer, or log it once you're done.
3. Watch the streak, the stats and the rank build.

In English, Spanish, Korean, Chinese, Vietnamese and Arabic.

Free to use. No ads, and we never sell your data. Tutti Pro adds advanced statistics, the full rank breakdown, unlimited friends, battles and leaderboards, and unlimited repertoire, notes and performances.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://tuttipracticeapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tuttipracticeapp.com/privacy

leads.description:
Start learning Russian with words and phrases you can listen to, read and practice at your own pace. English meanings and pronunciation guides help you connect Russian script with its sound and meaning.

CHOOSE WHAT TO LEARN
Explore 252 lessons across 26 chapters, beginning with the alphabet, greetings and numbers. Build vocabulary for food, family, home, work, travel, transport, nature and more.

Prefer a focused route? Choose from five mini courses: Starter Pack, Travel Basics, Food & Restaurant, Family & Home, and Health & Emergency. These bring related lessons together so you can study a useful topic.

LISTEN AND REVIEW
Listen to bundled recordings with two voice options, Ivan and Anna. Adjust playback speed and repeat words or phrases while you practice. The lesson text and bundled recordings work offline after installation. Purchases, ads and sending support messages require an internet connection.

PUT YOUR RECALL TO WORK
Review with flashcards, answer multiple-choice and true-or-false questions, match words with their meanings, and type answers in writing exercises. Revisit words that need more practice and check your exercise results.

MAKE STUDYING PERSONAL
Save favorite words and phrases for quick review. Follow your learning progress, record daily check-ins and set study reminders with notification permission. Choose a theme and learning appearance that suits you.

KEEP A COPY OF YOUR PROGRESS
Use manual Backup & Restore to export your favorites, progress, exercise history and included preferences to a file. Import a compatible backup when you need it. Purchases and notification permissions are not transferred in the backup.

HELP IMPROVE THE CONTENT
Use the flag beside a word to prepare a report about its audio, translation or example. You can also open Feedback & Support in Settings or contact support@dugloapps.app.

ACCESS
Some learning content is available without a purchase. Access to all lessons and premium features requires a one-time purchase or subscription. See the in-app purchase screen for available plans and terms.

Privacy Policy: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-russian/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-russian/terms/

leads.description:
Start speaking like a native. Speak Pro turns real YouTube videos into your personal speaking practice studio. Using the proven shadowing method trusted by interpreters and polyglots, you'll finally bridge the gap between knowing a language and actually speaking it.

Shadowing isn't just repetition — it's how your brain learns fluency naturally. Watch native speakers, repeat what they say in real-time, and train your mouth to move at native speed. It's the secret behind confident, natural speech.

Perfect for language learning, career prep, or mastering English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, and more.

• Listen: follow every line with its translation
• Shadow: repeat after the speaker and see which words were clear
• Type: write what you hear to train your ears

► Speak English with AI, 24/7
Talk out loud with Ava, your AI English partner, in a live voice conversation. She adapts to your level and corrects you as you go. No schedule, no pressure.

► Practice 65 real-life situations
A job interview, a doctor's visit, ordering food, asking for directions. Ava plays the other person, and you can repeat the same situation as many times as you need.

► Live speaking practice with other learners

► English speaking groups
Join a voice room with up to 8 learners, pick a topic and a level, and talk. Ask questions, make mistakes, help each other.

► Messages with corrections
Write to other learners by text or voice note and get your English corrected right inside the conversation.

► A community of 700,000+ English learners
Post in English with text, photos or voice notes, and get feedback in the comments. You never practice alone.

► A streak that keeps you going
Practice a little every day, keep your streak, and save the words you want to remember.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Word meanings and sentence translations in Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Turkish, Russian, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and more.

leads.description:
Learn to speak English, Spanish, French, Japanese, Italian, German, Portuguese, Mandarin Chinese or Korean by actually speaking them.

ConvoLive is speaking practice with an AI tutor. You talk out loud, an AI character talks back, and you work through real situations: ordering coffee, checking into a hotel, getting through an airport. Nothing to schedule, and a partner who is never going to judge you.

No subscription, no paywall

Most language apps put spoken conversation behind a paid tier. ConvoLive does not. There is no premium plan, no locked scenario library, and no trial that expires. Sign up with an email address, Google or Apple, with no password to remember, and there are no payment details to enter.

A town that remembers you

Open the app and you land in your town: a cast of characters you keep meeting, relationships that grow the longer you talk to them, and a day counter and a journal that track where you have been. Want to jump straight into one situation instead? Quick chat keeps the full scenario list on hand.

Why speaking works

Flashcard apps train you to recognise words. They do not train your mouth. Most learners can read far more than they can say, and that gap only closes one way, which is practice saying things out loud to somebody who answers.

Challenges: show how far you've come

Five lines with a character from your course. They speak, you answer before the timer runs out, and you are scored on what you actually said. Your camera records the whole round as a vertical video, ready for Instagram Reels, TikTok or your Stories. Post your first shaky attempt, then post the day you get five out of five. Nothing shows progress like watching yourself actually speak the language.

Real goals, not open-ended chat

Every conversation opens with a short list of things to get done. Order three apples. Ask for the total. Each one ticks off the moment you actually do it, and nothing is scripted, so the tick is proof you got there yourself. It is also how you know you are finished, which a chat window that just keeps going never tells you.

Every turn is spoken

You cannot type your way through this one. Your AI partner answers what you actually said, not what a script was expecting.

Feedback from your teacher after every chat

When a conversation ends, Teacher Mia goes back over what you said and gives you up to three short tips: a mistake worth fixing, a more natural way to put something, or what you got right. It is the note a tutor would give you, after every conversation instead of once a week.

A way out when you freeze

A few suggested lines are always sitting there. Play one to hear how it should sound, say it yourself, or translate it first if you are not sure what it means. When the thing you want to say is not among them, type that in your own language and get it back in the language you are learning, without leaving the conversation.

Tap any word and understand it in context

The word gets explained right where it sits, in the sense the sentence is actually using, rather than the one a dictionary happens to list first. If it was the whole sentence that got away from you, that is a tap as well.

Build your own scenario

Need something the courses do not cover? Describe the situation and ConvoLive builds it. Ask your partner's father for their hand in marriage. Complain about a hotel room. Compliment a quiche. If you are going to have to say it, you can practice it here first.

Who it is for

Beginners who want to speak from day one. Intermediate learners who can read a language but freeze in person. Travellers with a trip already booked. Anyone who finished a streak-based app and still cannot hold a conversation.

Languages

Practice languages: English, Spanish, French, Japanese, Italian, German, Portuguese, Mandarin Chinese and Korean, with more coming. Interface languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian, Turkish, Indonesian and Hindi.

When a conversation ends, Teacher Mia goes back over what you said and gives you up to three short tips: a mistake worth fixing, a more natural way to put something, or what you got right. It is the note a tutor would give you, after every conversation instead of once a week.

A way out when you freeze

A few suggested lines are always sitting there. Play one to hear how it should sound, say it yourself, or translate it first if you are not sure what it means. When the thing you want to say is not among them, type that in your own language and get it back in the language you are learning, without leaving the conversation.

Tap any word and understand it in context

The word gets explained right where it sits, in the sense the sentence is actually using, rather than the one a dictionary happens to list first. If it was the whole sentence that got away from you, that is a tap as well.

Build your own scenario

Need something the courses do not cover? Describe the situation and ConvoLive builds it. Ask your partner's father for their hand in marriage. Complain about a hotel room. Compliment a quiche. If you are going to have to say it, you can practice it here first.

Who it is for

Beginners who want to speak from day one. Intermediate learners who can read a language but freeze in person. Travellers with a trip already booked. Anyone who finished a streak-based app and still cannot hold a conversation.

Languages

Practice languages: English, Spanish, French, Japanese, Italian, German, Portuguese, Mandarin Chinese and Korean, with more coming. Interface languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian, Turkish, Indonesian and Hindi.

leads.description:
LEARN VOCABULARY SUCCESSFULLY

With the phase6 vocabulary trainer, you can prepare perfectly for your next vocabulary test. Plus, you’ll also remember what you’ve learned for the long term ;-).

Developed in Germany, phase6 is especially designed for students learning with German schoolbooks or attending schools in Germany and Austria. It also offers content for learners of German as a second or foreign language (DaZ / DaF) and includes materials from adult education courses such as the VHS.

Our approach combines proven scientific methods with fun, motivating learning experiences – helping you learn vocabulary faster and more effectively.

phase6 has been helping students succeed for over 20 years.

• • •

LEARN VOCABULARY EXACTLY AS IN YOUR TEXTBOOK

Find vocabulary sets that match your schoolbooks from leading publishers like Klett, Cornelsen, C.C. Buchner, PONS, and more.
Whether you’re learning with Green Line, Découvertes, À Plus!, Go Ahead, Lighthouse, Campus, or many others – we’ve got them all.
That means you learn exactly the vocabulary covered in class.
With over 1,400 vocabulary collections, your textbook is sure to be included.

• • •

YOUR VOCABULARY, YOUR PACE

The app adapts to your individual learning progress to ensure stress-free, effective studying.
phase6 repeats your vocabulary at increasing intervals – using a spaced repetition system based on the proven Leitner method – until every word truly sticks.

• • •

NEW – THE PHASE6 GRAMMAR TRAINER

Your companion for mastering English grammar.

Review and strengthen grammar topics from grade 5 onwards.

Practice with vocabulary you already know and work through engaging, topic-based exercises.

Our AI provides personalized feedback to help you master even tricky grammar points.

• • •

AN AWARD-WINNING LEARNING METHOD

Trusted by over 15,000 teachers – and for good reason. phase6’s scientifically grounded spaced repetition learning system helps you store vocabulary securely in your long-term memory. So you’re not just learning for the next test – you’re learning for life ;-).

The grammar trainer works the same way: with helpful hints, tips, and example sentences that guide you naturally to the right answer.
phase6 has been recognized with the Comenius EduMedia Seal 2025.

Independent research by hopp Marktforschung confirms that more than 87% of students improve their grades and 98% recommend phase6.

• • •

EVERYTHING YOU NEED FOR LANGUAGE SUCCESS

■ 1,400+ vocabulary sets – perfectly aligned with your schoolbooks
■ Science-based learning – memorize vocabulary for the long term
■ Includes English grammar practice – because language is more than words
■ Motivating learning stats – track and celebrate your progress
■ Learn anywhere – at home or on the go, on desktop, smartphone, or tablet
■ Stay focused – a distraction-free, ad-free learning environment

• • •

YOUR PATH TO SUCCESS

Notebook, tablet or smartphone – with phase6 you can learn vocabulary anytime, anywhere.

Try the phase6 vocabulary and grammar trainer free for 7 days – full access, no commitment.

For more information, resources, and language-learning tips, visit www.phase6.de.

Flexi is an AI-powered vocabulary builder and language-learning flashcard app that turns a word or short expression into ready-to-study cards in seconds. Compare options for different meanings, edit any detail, and save one or several cards to your deck.

Each AI-generated flashcard can include a translation, contextual example, definition, part of speech, and—where supported—a written pronunciation guide. Flexi then schedules reviews with FSRS-powered spaced repetition to help you remember vocabulary long term.

WHY LEARN WITH FLEXI?

- AI Flashcard Maker: Enter a word or short expression and get several editable card options for relevant meanings.

- Complete Vocabulary Cards: Generate translations, examples, definitions, parts of speech, and pronunciation guides based on your deck’s language and settings.

- Pronunciation Guides: Generate IPA for English, Spanish, German, Dutch, Czech, Finnish, and Romanian; kana for Japanese; Pinyin or Zhuyin for Mandarin Chinese; and Jyutping for Cantonese.

- Spaced Repetition: Study and memorize new words with FSRS-based scheduling that plans reviews at the right time.

- Text-to-Speech Audio: Hear words and examples to practice listening and pronunciation.

- Flexible Card Creation: Add one card, select several meanings at once, or paste a word list to create flashcards in bulk.

- Easy Imports: Bring your existing study decks from Anki, Quizlet, or CSV files.

- English Vocabulary Sets: Start learning immediately with curated, ready-made word sets.

- Quick Notes: Save words you meet in videos, books, or conversations and turn them into flashcards later.

- Track Your Progress: Follow your learning progress and study comfortably with Dark Mode.

FLEXI PREMIUM

- Interactive AI Language Tutor: Ask questions about any flashcard, explore nuances, and practice fill-in-the-blank exercises at your level.

- AI and Personal Images: Generate or upload images to strengthen visual memory.

- Topic-Based Vocabulary: Build word sets for travel, business, idioms, small talk, and more.

- Full Catalog Access: Unlock all curated English vocabulary sets.

SUPPORTED LANGUAGES

English, Spanish, French, German, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Turkish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Polish, Ukrainian, Hungarian, Czech, Thai, Hebrew, Vietnamese, Finnish, Romanian, and Serbian.

Try Flexi Premium free for 7 days and build a vocabulary study system that fits your goals.

leads.description:
LEARN KOREAN: ALPHABET, VOCABULARY & GRAMMAR

Korean letters were designed to be simple and logical. Discover the hidden meanings behind them, then go deeper with vocabulary and grammar.

Go from zero to reading Korean, then keep going. Master all 40 letters of Hangul (also written Hangeul) through King Sejong's animated story, then build real vocabulary: greetings, food, family, travel, emotions, and much more.

VOLUME 1: THE BIRTH OF HANGUL. FREE.

All 15 chapters are completely free:

◆ All 19 Korean consonants
◆ All 21 vowels
◆ Batchim (final consonants) and sound-change rules
◆ Interactive syllable builder
◆ Every letter recorded in my own voice
◆ King Sejong's story
◆ Three milestone tests

By the end, you can read any Korean word.

VOLUME 2: AFTER SEJONG

The story didn't end when the alphabet was invented. 15 new chapters and 3 trials, told through the century Korea nearly lost its language:

◆ Both counting systems, telling time, dates, big numbers, and money
◆ Korean names, family words, loanwords, and the two Koreas
◆ Hanja: the roots hiding inside Korean words
◆ A real Hangul keyboard, taught key by key
◆ Included with Pro

FREE VOCABULARY TO GET YOU STARTED

Finish the alphabet and the Vocab road opens:

◆ 40 Korean words free: greetings, polite phrases and the small words every sentence needs
◆ Quizzes that change every time you play: matching, audio, fill-in-the-blank, sentence building
◆ Korean audio for every word and every example sentence
◆ Tap a word in an example sentence to see how it's built
◆ Collect every word as a card in your personal collection
◆ Boss battles that test what you've learned
◆ Your first arcade game, free and unlimited

GRAMMAR: YOUR FIRST LESSONS

Finish the alphabet and grammar opens too:

◆ Your first three lessons free: say what something is, ask what it is, and say what you have
◆ New lessons added as they're ready

GO FURTHER: PRO

Pro unlocks the rest of Korean:

◆ Volume 2 of the story, all 15 chapters
◆ 70+ more vocabulary topics (body, family, food, verbs, nature, emotions, work, culture, travel) and everything I add next
◆ Every grammar lesson, including the ones I add next
◆ Mastery: review that brings each word back right before you forget it
◆ Every arcade game
◆ All boss battles

WHY HAN•GL IS DIFFERENT

◆ STORY-BASED LEARNING
Follow King Sejong's invention of Hangul. Learn through narrative, not flashcards.

◆ KOREAN AUDIO ON EVERYTHING
The alphabet course is my own voice. Every vocabulary word and sentence has high-quality Korean audio, so nothing is ever silent.

◆ WORKS OFFLINE
Every lesson, quiz, and audio clip installs with the app. After the first launch, learn on the subway, on a plane, anywhere.

◆ MADE BY ONE PERSON
I'm a native Korean, English, and Spanish speaker, and I made all of this myself: the curriculum, every screen, the voice on every letter, and the code underneath.

THE HANGUL TEACHING METHOD

King Sejong designed each consonant as a visual guide to pronunciation. The letter for "g" shows a tongue blocking your throat. The letter for "n" shows a tongue touching the roof of your mouth. The letter for "m" shows a closed mouth. The vowels are built from three symbols: heaven, earth, and man.

FEATURES

◆ 30 story chapters across two volumes
◆ A built-in Hangul keyboard and typing practice
◆ Arcade games, most of them built from the words you collect
◆ Word of the Day widget: a Korean word you can read, every morning
◆ Home screen widgets for your streak and your next step
◆ XP, levels, and daily streaks
◆ Instant feedback on every answer
◆ Optional romanization
◆ No ads, ever

START YOUR KOREAN JOURNEY

Download HAN•GL. Learn the full alphabet for free. Then keep going with Pro.

If you want to learn Korean but don't know where to start, this is it.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
